        cache_dir.join(format!("{app_id}.cover-header.jpg")),
        cache_dir.join(format!("{app_id}.cover-header.png")),
        cache_dir.join(format!("{app_id}.cover-header.jpeg")),
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .find(|path| artwork_remote::is_valid_cached_image(path))
}

fn cached_cover(cache_dir: &Path, app_id: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    cached_portrait(cache_dir, app_id).or_else(|| cached_header(cache_dir, app_id))
}

fn is_header_art(path: &Path) -> bool {
    path.file_name()
        .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
        .is_some_and(|name| name.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("header"))
}

fn find_cover(steam_root: Option<&Path>, app_id: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let root = steam_root?;
    let directories = [
        root.join("appcache").join("librarycache"),
        root.join("steamapps").join("librarycache"),
    ];
    let suffixes = [
        "_library_600x900_2x.jpg", "_library_600x900.jpg", "_library_600x900.png",
        "_library_600x900.jpeg", "_header.jpg", "_header.png",
    ];

    for directory in &directories {
        for suffix in suffixes {
            let path = directory.join(format!("{app_id}{suffix}"));
            if artwork_remote::is_valid_cached_image(&path) {
                return Some(path);
            }
        }
        let app_cache = directory.join(app_id);
        if let Some(path) = search_artwork_directory(&app_cache, 4) {
            return Some(path);
        }
    }
    None
}

fn search_artwork_directory(directory: &Path, depth: usize) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    if depth == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let entries = fs::read_dir(directory).ok()?.flatten().map(|entry| entry.path()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let preferred = [
        "library_600x900_2x.jpg", "library_600x900.jpg", "library_600x900.png",
        "library_600x900.jpeg", "library_capsule.jpg", "library_capsule.png",
        "library_header.jpg", "header.jpg", "header.png",
    ];
    for filename in preferred {
        if let Some(path) = entries.iter().find(|path| {
            path.file_name().and_then(|name| name.to_str()) == Some(filename)
                && artwork_remote::is_valid_cached_image(path)
        }) {
            return Some(path.clone());
        }
    }
    for path in entries {
        if path.is_dir() {
            if let Some(found) = search_artwork_directory(&path, depth - 1) {
                return Some(found);
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

fn sort_by_name(snapshot: &mut LibrarySnapshot) {
    snapshot.entries.sort_by(|left, right| {
        left.name
            .to_lowercase()
            .cmp(&right.name.to_lowercase())
            .then_with(|| left.key.cmp(&right.key))
    });
}



===== FILE: src\backend\artwork_json.rs =====
//! Small JSON string extractor used for Steam API app metadata.
//!
//! Steam responses are only used as optional display metadata, so a minimal
//! string reader keeps the app self-contained without coupling library scans
//! to a second JSON dependency.

/// Returns the first non-empty JSON string value associated with a key.
pub(super) fn json_string_for_key(source: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let needle = format!("\"{key}\"");
    let mut search_from = 0;
    while let Some(offset) = source.get(search_from..)?.find(&needle) {
        let key_start = search_from + offset;
        let mut index = key_start + needle.len();
        let bytes = source.as_bytes();
        while bytes.get(index).is_some_and(u8::is_ascii_whitespace) {
            index += 1;
        }
        if bytes.get(index) != Some(&b':') {
            search_from = key_start + needle.len();
            continue;
        }
        index += 1;
        while bytes.get(index).is_some_and(u8::is_ascii_whitespace) {
            index += 1;
        }
        if bytes.get(index) == Some(&b'"') {
            if let Some(value) = parse_json_string(source, index) {
                if !value.trim().is_empty() {
                    return Some(value);
                }
            }
        }
        search_from = key_start + needle.len();
    }
    None
}

fn parse_json_string(source: &str, quote_index: usize) -> Option<String> {
    let bytes = source.as_bytes();
    if bytes.get(quote_index) != Some(&b'"') {
        return None;
    }
    let mut output = String::new();
    let mut index = quote_index + 1;

    while index < bytes.len() {
        match bytes[index] {
            b'"' => return Some(output),
            b'\\' => {
                index += 1;
                match *bytes.get(index)? {
                    b'"' => output.push('"'),
                    b'\\' => output.push('\\'),
                    b'/' => output.push('/'),
                    b'b' => output.push('\u{0008}'),
                    b'f' => output.push('\u{000C}'),
                    b'n' => output.push('\n'),
                    b'r' => output.push('\r'),
                    b't' => output.push('\t'),
                    b'u' => {
                        let first = read_hex_quad(bytes, index + 1)?;
                        index += 4;
                        let codepoint = if (0xD800..=0xDBFF).contains(&first)
                            && bytes
                                .get(index + 1..index + 3)
                                .is_some_and(|sequence| sequence == b"\\u")
                        {
                            let second = read_hex_quad(bytes, index + 3)?;
                            if !(0xDC00..=0xDFFF).contains(&second) {
                                return None;
                            }
                            index += 6;
                            0x10000 + (((first as u32 - 0xD800) << 10) | (second as u32 - 0xDC00))
                        } else {
                            first as u32
                        };
                        output.push(char::from_u32(codepoint)?);
                    }
                    _ => return None,
                }
            }
            byte if byte < 0x20 => return None,
            _ => {
                let character = source.get(index..)?.chars().next()?;
                output.push(character);
                index += character.len_utf8() - 1;
            }
        }
        index += 1;
    }
    None
}

fn read_hex_quad(bytes: &[u8], start: usize) -> Option<u16> {
    let slice = bytes.get(start..start + 4)?;
    let mut value = 0u16;
    for &byte in slice {
        value = value.checked_mul(16)? + match byte {
            b'0'..=b'9' => (byte - b'0') as u16,
            b'a'..=b'f' => (byte - b'a' + 10) as u16,
            b'A'..=b'F' => (byte - b'A' + 10) as u16,
            _ => return None,
        };
    }
    Some(value)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{json_string_for_key, parse_json_string};

    #[test]
    fn reads_game_name_from_steam_api_json() {
        let body = r#"{"123":{"success":true,"data":{"name":"A Game: The Sequel"}}}"#;
        assert_eq!(json_string_for_key(body, "name").as_deref(), Some("A Game: The Sequel"));
    }


    #[test]
    fn reads_nested_steamcmd_app_info_name() {
        let body = r#"{"data":{"620":{"common":{"name":"Portal 2","type":"Game"}}},"status":"success"}"#;
        assert_eq!(json_string_for_key(body, "name").as_deref(), Some("Portal 2"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn decodes_json_escapes_and_unicode() {
        assert_eq!(parse_json_string(r#""A \"quoted\" title""#, 0).as_deref(), Some("A \"quoted\" title"));
        assert_eq!(parse_json_string(r#""Pok\u00e9mon""#, 0).as_deref(), Some("Pokémon"));
    }
}


===== FILE: src\backend\artwork_remote.rs =====
//! Public Steam Store metadata and artwork CDN lookups for numeric App IDs.

use std::fs::{self, File};
use std::io::Read;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::{Command, Output};

use super::artwork_json::json_string_for_key;
#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
use super::steam;

#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;

const CONNECT_TIMEOUT: &str = "2";
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT: &str = "6";
const IMAGE_TIMEOUT: &str = "3";

/// Minimal metadata needed to show a title and an image without an API key.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub(crate) struct AppMetadata {
    /// Human-readable name returned by the Steam Store.
    pub name: Option<String>,
    /// Official landscape header-art URL supplied by the Store API.
    pub header_image: Option<String>,
    /// Store capsule image URLs used if library artwork is unavailable.
    pub capsule_image: Option<String>,
    /// Older Store capsule image URL exposed alongside `capsule_image`.
    pub capsule_image_v5: Option<String>,
}

/// Looks up a name and its official Store header image from an App ID.
pub(crate) fn fetch_app_metadata(app_id: &str) -> Option<AppMetadata> {
    let store_url = format!(
        "https://store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails?appids={app_id}&l=english"
    );
    let store_body = fetch_json(&store_url, 1_000_000);
    let mut name = store_body
        .as_deref()
        .and_then(|body| json_string_for_key(body, "name"))
        .map(|name| name.trim().to_owned())
        .filter(|name| !name.is_empty() && name.len() < 512);
    let header_image = store_body
        .as_deref()
        .and_then(|body| json_string_for_key(body, "header_image"))
        .filter(|url| is_steam_image_url(url));
    let capsule_image = store_body
        .as_deref()
        .and_then(|body| json_string_for_key(body, "capsule_image"))
        .filter(|url| is_steam_image_url(url));
    let capsule_image_v5 = store_body
        .as_deref()
        .and_then(|body| json_string_for_key(body, "capsule_imagev5"))
        .filter(|url| is_steam_image_url(url));

    // Some App IDs do not have a useful Store page (for example tools or
    // dedicated-server entries). SteamCMD's public app-info service provides
    // a second way to resolve the display name for those IDs.
    if name.is_none() {
        let fallback_url = format!("https://api.steamcmd.net/v1/info/{app_id}");
        name = fetch_json(&fallback_url, 2_000_000)
            .and_then(|body| json_string_for_key(&body, "name"))
            .map(|name| name.trim().to_owned())
            .filter(|name| !name.is_empty() && name.len() < 512);
    }

    (name.is_some() || header_image.is_some() || capsule_image.is_some() || capsule_image_v5.is_some())
        .then_some(AppMetadata {
            name,
            header_image,
            capsule_image,
            capsule_image_v5,
        })
}

fn fetch_json(url: &str, maximum_size: usize) -> Option<String> {
    let output = run_curl([
        "--fail",
        "--location",
        "--silent",
        "--show-error",
        "--connect-timeout",
        CONNECT_TIMEOUT,
        "--max-time",
        REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
        "--header",
        "User-Agent: Locomotive/0.0.1",
        url,
    ])?;
    if output.stdout.len() > maximum_size {
        return None;
    }
    String::from_utf8(output.stdout).ok()
}

/// Downloads portrait library artwork first, then uses other Store artwork as a fallback.
pub(crate) fn download_cover(
    cache_dir: &Path,
    app_id: &str,
    metadata: Option<&AppMetadata>,
) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    // A previous build may have cached a wide header banner. Do not let it stop
    // us from trying the actual portrait library capsule.
    for extension in ["jpg", "png", "jpeg"] {
        let cached = cache_dir.join(format!("{app_id}.cover.{extension}"));
        if is_image_file(&cached, extension) {
            return Some(cached);
        }
    }

    let header_image = metadata.and_then(|metadata| metadata.header_image.as_deref());

    // Newer Steam images can live in app-ID/hash/asset.jpg paths. The Store API
    // gives us the exact header URL, so try portrait files beside that image.
    if let Some(url) = header_image.filter(|url| is_steam_image_url(url)) {
        for filename in ["library_600x900_2x.jpg", "library_600x900.jpg"] {
            if let Some(candidate) = sibling_asset_url(url, filename) {
                if let Some(path) = download_image(cache_dir, app_id, &candidate, "jpg", false) {
                    return Some(path);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Try a small set of current and legacy AppID-only paths. Keeping this list
    // short avoids a long silent wait when an App ID has no portrait artwork.
    let candidates = [
        format!("https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/{app_id}/library_600x900_2x.jpg"),
        format!("https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/{app_id}/library_600x900.jpg"),
        format!("https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/{app_id}/library_600x900.jpg"),
        format!("https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/{app_id}/library_600x900.jpg"),
    ];

    for url in candidates {
        if let Some(path) = download_image(cache_dir, app_id, &url, "jpg", false) {
            return Some(path);
        }
    }

    // A portrait is not available for every App ID. Try exact Store image URLs
    // next so even games without library capsules can still show official art.
    for url in [
        header_image,
        metadata.and_then(|metadata| metadata.capsule_image.as_deref()),
        metadata.and_then(|metadata| metadata.capsule_image_v5.as_deref()),
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .flatten()
    .filter(|url| is_steam_image_url(url))
    {
        let extension = image_extension(url).unwrap_or("jpg");
        if let Some(path) = download_image(cache_dir, app_id, url, extension, true) {
            return Some(path);
        }
    }

    // Last resort for App IDs whose Store response lacks artwork metadata.
    for url in [
        format!("https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/{app_id}/header.jpg"),
        format!("https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/{app_id}/header.jpg"),
    ] {
        if let Some(path) = download_image(cache_dir, app_id, &url, "jpg", true) {
            return Some(path);
        }
    }

    // If all remote requests fail but an old header is cached, keep displaying
    // it rather than replacing artwork with an empty tile.
    for extension in ["jpg", "png", "jpeg"] {
        let cached_header = cache_dir.join(format!("{app_id}.cover-header.{extension}"));
        if is_image_file(&cached_header, extension) {
            return Some(cached_header);
        }
    }
    None
}

fn sibling_asset_url(image_url: &str, filename: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let clean_url = image_url.split(|character| character == '?' || character == '#').next()?;
    let (directory, _) = clean_url.rsplit_once('/')?;
    Some(format!("{directory}/{filename}"))
}

fn download_image(
    cache_dir: &Path,
    app_id: &str,
    url: &str,
    extension: &str,
    is_header: bool,
) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let filename = if is_header {
        format!("{app_id}.cover-header.{extension}")
    } else {
        format!("{app_id}.cover.{extension}")
    };
    let destination = cache_dir.join(filename);
    if is_image_file(&destination, extension) {
        return Some(destination);
    }
    let _ = fs::remove_file(&destination);

    let temporary = cache_dir.join(format!("{app_id}.cover.part"));
    let _ = fs::remove_file(&temporary);
    let temporary_path = temporary.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
    let result = run_curl([
        "--fail",
        "--location",
        "--silent",
        "--show-error",
        "--connect-timeout",
        CONNECT_TIMEOUT,
        "--max-time",
        IMAGE_TIMEOUT,
        "--header",
        "User-Agent: Locomotive/0.0.1",
        "--output",
        &temporary_path,
        url,
    ]);

    if result.is_none() || !is_image_file(&temporary, extension) {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(temporary);
        return None;
    }
    if fs::rename(&temporary, &destination).is_ok() {
        Some(destination)
    } else {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(temporary);
        is_image_file(&destination, extension).then_some(destination)
    }
}

pub(crate) fn is_valid_cached_image(path: &Path) -> bool {
    let Some(extension) = path.extension().and_then(|extension| extension.to_str()) else {
        return false;
    };
    is_image_file(path, &extension.to_ascii_lowercase())
}

fn is_image_file(path: &Path, extension: &str) -> bool {
    let Ok(metadata) = fs::metadata(path) else {
        return false;
    };
    if metadata.len() < 512 {
        return false;
    }
    let Ok(mut file) = File::open(path) else {
        return false;
    };
    let mut signature = [0; 8];
    let Ok(length) = file.read(&mut signature) else {
        return false;
    };
    match extension {
        "png" => length == 8 && signature == [137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10],
        "jpg" | "jpeg" => {
            length >= 3 && signature[0] == 255 && signature[1] == 216 && signature[2] == 255
        }
        _ => false,
    }
}

fn image_extension(url: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
    let path = url.split(|character| character == '?' || character == '#').next()?;
    let extension = path.rsplit('.').next()?.to_ascii_lowercase();
    match extension.as_str() {
        "png" => Some("png"),
        "jpeg" => Some("jpeg"),
        "jpg" => Some("jpg"),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn is_steam_image_url(url: &str) -> bool {
    let Some((scheme, rest)) = url.split_once("://") else {
        return false;
    };
    if scheme != "https" {
        return false;
    }

    let host = rest.split('/').next().unwrap_or_default();
    host == "steamstatic.com"
        || host.ends_with(".steamstatic.com")
        || host == "steampowered.com"
        || host.ends_with(".steampowered.com")
}

fn run_curl<const N: usize>(arguments: [&str; N]) -> Option<Output> {
    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
    let mut command = Command::new("curl.exe");
    #[cfg(not(target_os = "windows"))]
    let mut command = Command::new("curl");
    command.args(arguments);
    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
    command.creation_flags(steam::CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
    command.output().ok().filter(|output| output.status.success())
}


#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{image_extension, is_steam_image_url, sibling_asset_url};

    #[test]
    fn portrait_lookup_reuses_hashed_store_asset_directory() {
        let url = "https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/12345/abc987/header.jpg?t=123";
        assert_eq!(
            sibling_asset_url(url, "library_600x900.jpg").as_deref(),
            Some("https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/12345/abc987/library_600x900.jpg"),
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn steam_image_urls_can_include_cache_busters() {
        let url = "https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/12345/header.jpg?t=123";
        assert!(is_steam_image_url(url));
        assert_eq!(image_extension(url), Some("jpg"));
    }
}


===== FILE: src\backend\file_dialog.rs =====
//! Native file and folder dialogs using platform-provided utilities.

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::process::Command;

use super::steam::CREATE_NO_WINDOW;
use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;

pub(crate) fn choose_files() -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
    let script = r#"
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
$dialog = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.OpenFileDialog
$dialog.Multiselect = $true
$dialog.CheckFileExists = $true
$dialog.Title = 'Import manifest and Lua files'
$dialog.Filter = 'Manifest and Lua files (*.manifest;*.manifests;*.lua)|*.manifest;*.manifests;*.lua|All files (*.*)|*.*'
if ($dialog.ShowDialog() -eq [System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult]::OK) {
    $dialog.FileNames | ForEach-Object { [Console]::WriteLine($_) }
}
"#;
    let mut command = Command::new("powershell.exe");
    command.args(["-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-STA", "-Command", script]);
    command.creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
    let output = command
        .output()
        .map_err(|error| format!("Could not open the file picker: {error}"))?;
    if !output.status.success() {
        return Err(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_owned());
    }
    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout)
        .lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .collect())
}

pub(crate) fn choose_directory() -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, String> {
    let script = r#"
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
$dialog = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.FolderBrowserDialog
$dialog.Description = 'Choose a local Locomotive library folder'
$dialog.ShowNewFolderButton = $true
if ($dialog.ShowDialog() -eq [System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult]::OK) {
    [Console]::WriteLine($dialog.SelectedPath)
}
"#;
    let mut command = Command::new("powershell.exe");
    command.args(["-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-STA", "-Command", script]);
    command.creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
    let output = command
        .output()
        .map_err(|error| format!("Could not open the folder picker: {error}"))?;
    if !output.status.success() {
        return Err(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_owned());
    }
    let path = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_owned();
    Ok((!path.is_empty()).then(|| PathBuf::from(path)))
}

===== FILE: src\backend\importer.rs =====
//! Validated import and removal operations for files in the local library.

use std::fs::{self, File};
use std::io::{BufReader, Read};
use std::path::Path;

use crate::state::{FileKind, PendingFile, library_state::{ImportOutcome, LibraryEntry, LibrarySnapshot}};

use super::{archive, library};

/// Copies staged inputs to the two local library folders and then rescans them.
pub(crate) fn import_files(
    manifest_dir: &Path,
    lua_dir: &Path,
    files: &[PendingFile],
) -> ImportOutcome {
    let settings = match archive::normalize_and_validate(manifest_dir.to_path_buf(), lua_dir.to_path_buf()) {
        Ok(settings) => settings,
        Err(error) => {
            return ImportOutcome {
                snapshot: failed_snapshot(error.clone()),
                imported: 0,
                skipped: files.len(),
                errors: vec![error],
            };
        }
    };

    let mut imported = 0;
    let mut skipped = 0;
    let mut errors = Vec::new();

    for file in files {
        let kind = FileKind::from_path(&file.path);
        if kind == FileKind::Unknown || kind != file.kind {
            skipped += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if !file.path.is_file() {
            skipped += 1;
            errors.push(format!("File no longer exists: {}", file.path.display()));
            continue;
        }
        let folder = match kind {
            FileKind::Manifest => &settings.manifest_dir,
            FileKind::Lua => &settings.lua_dir,
            FileKind::Unknown => continue,
        };
        if let Err(error) = fs::create_dir_all(folder) {
            skipped += 1;
            errors.push(format!("Could not create '{}': {error}", folder.display()));
            continue;
        }

        let Some(filename) = file.path.file_name() else {
            skipped += 1;
            errors.push(format!("File has no name: {}", file.path.display()));
            continue;
        };
        let destination = folder.join(filename);
        if same_file(&file.path, &destination) {
            skipped += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if destination.exists() {
            if same_contents(&file.path, &destination) {
                skipped += 1;
                continue;
            }
            skipped += 1;
            errors.push(format!(
                "A different file named '{}' already exists in '{}'. Rename one of the files before importing it.",
                filename.to_string_lossy(),
                folder.display()
            ));
            continue;
        }

        match fs::copy(&file.path, &destination) {
            Ok(_) => imported += 1,
            Err(error) => {
                skipped += 1;
                errors.push(format!(
                    "Could not copy '{}' to '{}': {error}",
                    file.path.display(),
                    destination.display()
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    ImportOutcome {
        snapshot: library::scan(&settings.manifest_dir, &settings.lua_dir),
        imported,
        skipped,
        errors,
    }
}

/// Deletes only the selected entry's files from the configured local library folders.
pub(crate) fn remove_entry(
    manifest_dir: &Path,
    lua_dir: &Path,
    entry: &LibraryEntry,
) -> Result<usize, String> {
    let settings = archive::normalize_and_validate(manifest_dir.to_path_buf(), lua_dir.to_path_buf())?;
    let mut removed = 0;
    let mut errors = Vec::new();

    for file in &entry.files {
        let expected_folder = match file.kind {
            FileKind::Manifest => &settings.manifest_dir,
            FileKind::Lua => &settings.lua_dir,
            FileKind::Unknown => continue,
        };
        if file.path.parent() != Some(expected_folder.as_path())
            || FileKind::from_path(&file.path) != file.kind
            || !file.path.is_file()
        {
            errors.push(format!("Refusing to remove a file outside the library: {}", file.path.display()));
            continue;
        }
        match fs::remove_file(&file.path) {
            Ok(()) => removed += 1,
            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
            Err(error) => errors.push(format!("Could not remove '{}': {error}", file.path.display())),
        }
    }

    if errors.is_empty() {
        Ok(removed)
    } else {
        Err(format!("Removed {removed} file(s), but some files could not be removed: {}", errors.join("; ")))
    }
}

fn same_file(source: &Path, destination: &Path) -> bool {
    source == destination
        || source
            .canonicalize()
            .ok()
            .zip(destination.canonicalize().ok())
            .is_some_and(|(left, right)| left == right)
}

fn same_contents(left: &Path, right: &Path) -> bool {
    let Ok(left_metadata) = fs::metadata(left) else {
        return false;
    };
    let Ok(right_metadata) = fs::metadata(right) else {
        return false;
    };
    if left_metadata.len() != right_metadata.len() {
        return false;
    }
    let Ok(left) = File::open(left) else { return false; };
    let Ok(right) = File::open(right) else { return false; };
    let mut left = BufReader::new(left);
    let mut right = BufReader::new(right);
    let mut left_buffer = [0_u8; 16 * 1024];
    let mut right_buffer = [0_u8; 16 * 1024];
    loop {
        let Ok(left_len) = left.read(&mut left_buffer) else { return false; };
        let Ok(right_len) = right.read(&mut right_buffer) else { return false; };
        if left_len != right_len || left_buffer[..left_len] != right_buffer[..right_len] {
            return false;
        }
        if left_len == 0 {
            return true;
        }
    }
}

fn failed_snapshot(error: String) -> LibrarySnapshot {
    LibrarySnapshot { entries: Vec::new(), error: Some(error) }
}


===== FILE: src\backend\keyvalues.rs =====
//! Small Valve KeyValues reader for Steam's local `.acf` and `.vdf` files.

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Value {
    /// An ordinary quoted or unquoted string.
    Scalar(String),
    /// A nested KeyValues object.
    Object(Vec<(String, Value)>),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Token {
    Text(String),
    Open,
    Close,
}

/// Parses KeyValues while tolerating comments and escaped Windows paths.
pub(crate) fn parse(source: &str) -> Vec<(String, Value)> {
    let tokens = tokenize(source);
    let mut index = 0;
    parse_nodes(&tokens, &mut index, false)
}

/// Finds a key without depending on Valve's inconsistent key casing.
pub(crate) fn find<'a>(nodes: &'a [(String, Value)], key: &str) -> Option<&'a Value> {
    nodes
        .iter()
        .find(|(candidate, _)| candidate.eq_ignore_ascii_case(key))
        .map(|(_, value)| value)
}

/// Returns a scalar value for a key.
pub(crate) fn scalar<'a>(nodes: &'a [(String, Value)], key: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
    match find(nodes, key)? {
        Value::Scalar(value) => Some(value),
        Value::Object(_) => None,
    }
}

/// Returns a nested object for a key.
pub(crate) fn object<'a>(
    nodes: &'a [(String, Value)],
    key: &str,
) -> Option<&'a [(String, Value)]> {
    match find(nodes, key)? {
        Value::Object(children) => Some(children),
        Value::Scalar(_) => None,
    }
}

fn tokenize(source: &str) -> Vec<Token> {
    let mut chars = source.chars().peekable();
    let mut tokens = Vec::new();

    while let Some(character) = chars.next() {
        match character {
            '{' => tokens.push(Token::Open),
            '}' => tokens.push(Token::Close),
            '/' if chars.peek() == Some(&'/') => {
                chars.next();
                for next in chars.by_ref() {
                    if next == '\n' {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            character if character.is_whitespace() => {}
            '"' => {
                let mut value = String::new();
                while let Some(next) = chars.next() {
                    match next {
                        '"' => break,
                        '\\' => match chars.next() {
                            Some('\\') => value.push('\\'),
                            Some('"') => value.push('"'),
                            Some(other) => {
                                value.push('\\');
                                value.push(other);
                            }
                            None => value.push('\\'),
                        },
                        other => value.push(other),
                    }
                }
                tokens.push(Token::Text(value));
            }
            first => {
                let mut value = String::from(first);
                while let Some(next) = chars.peek().copied() {
                    if next.is_whitespace() || next == '{' || next == '}' {
                        break;
                    }
                    value.push(next);
                    chars.next();
                }
                tokens.push(Token::Text(value));
            }
        }
    }

    tokens
}

fn parse_nodes(
    tokens: &[Token],
    index: &mut usize,
    nested: bool,
) -> Vec<(String, Value)> {
    let mut nodes = Vec::new();

    while *index < tokens.len() {
        if tokens[*index] == Token::Close {
            *index += 1;
            if nested {
                break;
            }
            continue;
        }

        let Token::Text(key) = &tokens[*index] else {
            *index += 1;
            continue;
        };
        let key = key.clone();
        *index += 1;
        if *index >= tokens.len() {
            break;
        }

        match &tokens[*index] {
            Token::Open => {
                *index += 1;
                nodes.push((key, Value::Object(parse_nodes(tokens, index, true))));
            }
            Token::Text(value) => {
                nodes.push((key, Value::Scalar(value.clone())));
                *index += 1;
            }
            Token::Close => {
                *index += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    nodes
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{Value, find, object, parse, scalar};

    #[test]
    fn parses_app_state_and_nested_depots() {
        let nodes = parse(
            r#""AppState" { "appid" "480" "name" "Spacewar" "InstalledDepots" { "123" { "manifest" "456" } } }"#,
        );
        let app_state = object(&nodes, "AppState").expect("appstate object should parse");
        assert_eq!(scalar(app_state, "appid"), Some("480"));
        assert_eq!(scalar(app_state, "name"), Some("Spacewar"));
        let depots = object(app_state, "InstalledDepots").expect("depots object should parse");
        assert!(matches!(find(depots, "123"), Some(Value::Object(_))));
    }

    #[test]
    fn decodes_escaped_windows_paths() {
        let nodes = parse(r#""library" { "0" { "path" "C:\\Steam Library" } }"#);
        let library = object(&nodes, "library").expect("library object should parse");
        let first = object(library, "0").expect("first library should parse");
        assert_eq!(scalar(first, "path"), Some("C:\\Steam Library"));
    }
}


===== FILE: src\backend\library.rs =====
//! Reconstructs the local archive into grouped entries on each scan.
//!
//! Grouping works in two passes:
//!
//!   1. Every `.lua` file is read and parsed for its app id and depot list.
//!      A `.lua` file named `2651280.lua` is an entry for app 2651280, and
//!      the depots it declares form a depot-to-app map.
//!   2. Every `.manifest` file is matched to an app through that map. A
//!      manifest that no Lua references still becomes an entry of its own,
//!      keyed by depot id.
//!
//! Steam metadata, when present, only improves display names. Grouping does
//! not depend on it, so uninstalled games still group correctly.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fs;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use crate::state::{FileKind, library_state::{LibraryEntry, LibraryFile, LibrarySnapshot}};

use super::artwork;
use super::lua_meta;
use super::steam::{self, AppInfo, SteamMetadata};

#[derive(Debug)]
struct EntryBuilder {
    key: String,
    name: String,
    name_is_fallback: bool,
    files: Vec<LibraryFile>,
}

/// Scans configured folders and uses read-only Steam metadata when available to improve names.
pub(crate) fn scan(manifest_dir: &Path, lua_dir: &Path) -> LibrarySnapshot {
    let metadata = steam::discover_root().and_then(|root| steam::read_metadata(&root).ok());
    scan_with_metadata(manifest_dir, lua_dir, metadata.as_ref())
}

/// Rebuilds library entries and enriches unknown app IDs with cached Steam names and covers.
pub(crate) fn refresh(manifest_dir: &Path, lua_dir: &Path) -> LibrarySnapshot {
    let mut snapshot = scan(manifest_dir, lua_dir);
    artwork::enrich_local(&mut snapshot);
    snapshot
}

fn scan_with_metadata(
    manifest_dir: &Path,
    lua_dir: &Path,
    metadata: Option<&SteamMetadata>,
) -> LibrarySnapshot {
    let empty_apps = HashMap::new();
    let empty_depot_owners = HashMap::new();
    let apps: &HashMap<String, AppInfo> = metadata.map(|layout| &layout.apps).unwrap_or(&empty_apps);
    let depot_owners: &HashMap<String, String> = metadata
        .map(|layout| &layout.depot_owners)
        .unwrap_or(&empty_depot_owners);

    let mut groups: HashMap<String, EntryBuilder> = HashMap::new();
    let mut depot_to_app: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();

    // Pass 1: read every Lua file, determine its app id, and register
    // the depots it declares. The app id comes from the Lua contents
    // first, from the filename stem second, and from Steam metadata only
    // as a display-name source.
    for (path, _) in collect_files(lua_dir, FileKind::Lua) {
        let meta = lua_meta::read(&path).unwrap_or_default();
        let stem = file_stem(&path);
        let app_id = numeric_stem(&stem);
        let key = match &app_id {
            Some(id) => format!("app:{id}"),
            None => format!("name:{}", normalized_key(&stem)),
        };
        let metadata_name = app_id
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|id| apps.get(id))
            .map(|app| app.name.clone());
        let name_is_fallback = metadata_name.is_none();
        let name = metadata_name.unwrap_or_else(|| display_stem(&stem));
        let entry = groups.entry(key.clone()).or_insert_with(|| EntryBuilder {
            key: key.clone(),
            name,
            name_is_fallback,
            files: Vec::new(),
        });
        entry.files.push(LibraryFile { path, kind: FileKind::Lua });

        if let Some(id) = &app_id {
            for depot in &meta.depots {
                depot_to_app.insert(depot.clone(), id.clone());
            }
        }
    }

    // Pass 2: read every manifest, resolve its depot to an app, and add it
    // to the matching group. Falls back to Steam's depot ownership map, then
    // to a standalone entry keyed by depot id.
    for (path, kind) in collect_files(manifest_dir, FileKind::Manifest) {
        let stem = file_stem(&path);
        let depot_id = manifest_depot_id(&stem);
        let app_id = depot_id
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|id| depot_to_app.get(id).cloned())
            .or_else(|| depot_id.as_ref().and_then(|id| depot_owners.get(id).cloned()));
        let key = match &app_id {
            Some(id) => format!("app:{id}"),
            None => match &depot_id {
                Some(id) => format!("depot:{id}"),
                None => format!("name:{}", normalized_key(&group_stem(&stem))),
            },
        };
        let metadata_name = app_id
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|id| apps.get(id))
            .map(|app| app.name.clone());
        let has_existing_group = groups.contains_key(&key);
        let fallback_name = metadata_name
            .clone()
            .or_else(|| groups.get(&key).map(|entry| entry.name.clone()))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| match &depot_id {
                Some(id) => format!("Depot {id}"),
                None => display_stem(&group_stem(&stem)),
            });
        let entry = groups.entry(key.clone()).or_insert_with(|| EntryBuilder {
            key,
            name: fallback_name,
            name_is_fallback: metadata_name.is_none() && !has_existing_group,
            files: Vec::new(),
        });
        entry.files.push(LibraryFile { path, kind });
    }

    let mut entries: Vec<LibraryEntry> = groups
        .into_values()
        .map(|mut entry| {
            entry.files.sort_by(|left, right| {
                let left_name = left.path.file_name().and_then(|name| name.to_str()).unwrap_or("");
                let right_name = right.path.file_name().and_then(|name| name.to_str()).unwrap_or("");
                left_name.to_lowercase().cmp(&right_name.to_lowercase())
            });
            LibraryEntry {
                key: entry.key,
                name: entry.name,
                name_is_fallback: entry.name_is_fallback,
                cover_path: None,
                files: entry.files,
            }
        })
        .collect();
    entries.sort_by(|left, right| {
        left.name
            .to_lowercase()
            .cmp(&right.name.to_lowercase())
            .then_with(|| left.key.cmp(&right.key))
    });

    LibrarySnapshot { entries, error: None }
}

fn collect_files(directory: &Path, expected: FileKind) -> Vec<(PathBuf, FileKind)> {
    let mut collected = Vec::new();
    let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(directory) else {
        return collected;
    };
    for entry in entries.flatten() {
        let path = entry.path();
        if path.is_file() && FileKind::from_path(&path) == expected {
            collected.push((path, expected));
        }
    }
    collected
}

fn numeric_stem(stem: &str) -> Option<String> {
    (!stem.is_empty() && stem.chars().all(|character| character.is_ascii_digit()))
        .then(|| stem.to_owned())
}

fn manifest_depot_id(stem: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let first = stem.split('_').next()?;
    (!first.is_empty() && first.chars().all(|character| character.is_ascii_digit()))
        .then(|| first.to_owned())
}

fn file_stem(path: &Path) -> String {
    path.file_stem()
        .and_then(|stem| stem.to_str())
        .unwrap_or("Unknown file")
        .to_owned()
}

fn group_stem(stem: &str) -> String {
    if let Some((prefix, suffix)) = stem.rsplit_once('_') {
        if !prefix.is_empty() && !suffix.is_empty() && suffix.chars().all(|character| character.is_ascii_digit()) {
            return prefix.to_owned();
        }
    }
    stem.to_owned()
}

fn normalized_key(value: &str) -> String {
    value.trim().to_lowercase()
}

fn display_stem(stem: &str) -> String {
    if !stem.is_empty() && stem.chars().all(|character| character.is_ascii_digit()) {
        return format!("App {stem}");
    }
    let name = stem.replace('_', " ").replace('-', " ").trim().to_owned();
    if name.is_empty() {
        "Unknown game".into()
    } else {
        name
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::{display_stem, group_stem, manifest_depot_id, numeric_stem};

    #[test]
    fn matching_file_stems_group_by_name() {
        assert_eq!(group_stem("MyGame_884422"), "MyGame");
        assert_eq!(group_stem("My_Game"), "My_Game");
        assert_eq!(display_stem("My_Game"), "My Game");
    }

    #[test]
    fn numeric_stems_are_accepted_as_app_ids() {
        assert_eq!(numeric_stem("2651280").as_deref(), Some("2651280"));
        assert_eq!(numeric_stem("MyGame"), None);
        assert_eq!(numeric_stem(""), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn depot_id_is_extracted_from_manifest_name() {
        assert_eq!(
            manifest_depot_id("2651281_2482069238759486759").as_deref(),
            Some("2651281"),
        );
        assert_eq!(manifest_depot_id("readme"), None);
    }
}

===== FILE: src\backend\lua_meta.rs =====
//! Minimal reader for BetterSteamTools-style Lua depot configuration files.
//!
//! Extracts the two facts the library screen needs to group a `.lua` file
//! with the `.manifest` files that belong to the same game:
//!
//!   - the app id, from the single-argument form:   addappid(APP_ID)
//!   - the depot ids, from the three-argument form: addappid(DEPOT_ID, 0, "key")
//!
//! No Lua is executed. The reader is intentionally permissive: it scans
//! for the function name, reads the numeric first argument, and skips
//! anything else. That is enough for grouping and it cannot fail on real
//! files, however they are formatted.

use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct LuaMeta {
    /// Values of every `addappid` call. Includes the base game and all DLCs.
    pub depots: Vec<String>,
}

/// Reads and parses a Lua file. Returns None if the file cannot be read.
pub(crate) fn read(path: &Path) -> Option<LuaMeta> {
    let text = fs::read_to_string(path).ok()?;
    Some(parse(&text))
}

/// Scans `text` for addappid calls and returns the app id and depot list.
pub(crate) fn parse(text: &str) -> LuaMeta {
    let mut meta = LuaMeta::default();
    let bytes = text.as_bytes();
    let needle = b"addappid";
    let mut search_from = 0usize;

    while search_from < bytes.len() {
        let rel = match text[search_from..].find("addappid") {
            Some(offset) => offset,
            None => break,
        };
        let start = search_from + rel;
        let end = start + needle.len();

        // Left word boundary: the char before must not be alphanumeric or _.
        if start > 0 {
            let prev = bytes[start - 1];
            if prev.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || prev == b'_' {
                search_from = end;
                continue;
            }
        }

        // Skip whitespace, then require an opening parenthesis.
        let mut open = end;
        while open < bytes.len() && (bytes[open] == b' ' || bytes[open] == b'\t') {
            open += 1;
        }
        if open >= bytes.len() || bytes[open] != b'(' {
            search_from = end;
            continue;
        }

        // Everything up to the next closing parenthesis is the argument list.
        let close_rel = match text[open..].find(')') {
            Some(offset) => offset,
            None => break,
        };
        let args_str = &text[open + 1..open + close_rel];
        search_from = open + close_rel + 1;

        let args: Vec<&str> = args_str.split(',').map(str::trim).collect();
        match args.len() {
            1 | 3 => {
                if is_digits(args[0]) {
                    meta.depots.push(args[0].to_owned());
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    meta
}

fn is_digits(value: &str) -> bool {
    !value.is_empty() && value.chars().all(|character| character.is_ascii_digit())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::parse;

    #[test]
    fn extracts_app_id_and_depots() {
        let source = r#"
            addappid(2651281,0,"9874571b52ba0c01cbdfd32c5d81920d1093f42fbcf76d02a1e4589746a3b497")
            setManifestid(2651281,"2482069238759486759")
            addappid(2651280)
        "#;
        let meta = parse(source);
        assert_eq!(meta.depots, vec!["2651281", "2651280"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn handles_many_depots_and_whitespace() {
        let source = "addappid( 100 )\naddappid( 200 , 0 , \"a\" )\naddappid(300,0,\"b\")";
        let meta = parse(source);
        assert_eq!(meta.depots, vec!["100", "200", "300"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ignores_other_function_calls() {
        let source = "setManifestid(999,\"1\")\naddtoken(1,\"2\")\naddappid(42)";
        let meta = parse(source);
        assert_eq!(meta.depots, vec!["42"]);
    }
}

===== FILE: src\backend\setup.rs =====
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use iced::futures::{SinkExt, StreamExt};
use iced::stream;
#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;

pub fn is_installed(steam_root: &Path) -> bool {
    steam_root.join("RustyTools.dll").exists()
}

pub fn is_steam_running() -> bool {
    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
    {
        let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new("tasklist");
        cmd.creation_flags(crate::backend::steam::CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
        cmd.args(["/FI", "IMAGENAME eq steam.exe", "/NH"]);
        if let Ok(out) = cmd.output() {
            let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
            return text.contains("steam.exe");
        }
        false
    }
    #[cfg(not(target_os = "windows"))]
    false
}

pub fn restart_steam() {
    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
    {
        let mut kill = std::process::Command::new("taskkill");
        kill.creation_flags(crate::backend::steam::CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
        let _ = kill.args(["/F", "/IM", "steam.exe"]).status();
        
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2));

        let mut start = std::process::Command::new("cmd");
        start.creation_flags(crate::backend::steam::CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
        let _ = start.args(["/C", "start steam://open/main"]).status();
    }
}

pub fn download_and_install(steam_root: PathBuf) -> impl iced::futures::Stream<Item = crate::message::Message> {
    stream::channel(100, move |mut output: iced::futures::channel::mpsc::Sender<crate::message::Message>| async move {
        let (tx, mut rx) = iced::futures::channel::mpsc::channel(100);
        let root = steam_root.clone();

        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut tx = tx;
            let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupProgress(0.05));
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(400));

            #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
            {
                let temp_dir = std::env::temp_dir().join("locomotive_setup");
                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&temp_dir);
                let zip_path = temp_dir.join("release.zip");
                
                let url = "https://github.com/Asper0000/rusty-tools/releases/latest/download/release.zip";

                // 1. Download
                let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new("curl.exe");
                cmd.creation_flags(crate::backend::steam::CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
                let output = cmd.args(["-L", "-s", "-o", zip_path.to_str().unwrap(), url]).output();
                
                match output {
                    Ok(out) if !out.status.success() => {
                        let err = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr);
                        let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
                        let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupFinished(Err(format!("Download failed. Status: {}. Err: {}. Out: {}", out.status, err, stdout))));
                        return;
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupFinished(Err(format!("Failed to run curl: {}", e))));
                        return;
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }

                // 1.5 Verify it's actually a ZIP (magic bytes 'PK')
                if let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(&zip_path) {
                    if bytes.len() < 2 || &bytes[0..2] != b"PK" {
                        let size = bytes.len();
                        let preview = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes[0..std::cmp::min(100, size)]).replace("\n", " ");
                        let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupFinished(Err(format!("Downloaded file is not a valid zip (Size: {}). It might be a 404 page. Preview: {}", size, preview))));
                        return;
                    }
                } else {
                    let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupFinished(Err("Could not read downloaded zip file.".into())));
                    return;
                }

                let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupProgress(0.4));
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(400));

                // 2. Extract AND copy DLLs using PowerShell
                let ps_script = format!(
                    "Expand-Archive -Path '{}' -DestinationPath '{}' -Force; Get-ChildItem -Path '{}' -Filter *.dll -Recurse | Copy-Item -Destination '{}' -Force",
                    zip_path.display(), temp_dir.display(), temp_dir.display(), root.display()
                );

                let mut ps = std::process::Command::new("powershell.exe");
                ps.creation_flags(crate::backend::steam::CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
                ps.args(["-NoProfile", "-Command", &ps_script]);
                let output = ps.output();
                
                match output {
                    Ok(out) if !out.status.success() => {
                        let err = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr);
                        let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupFinished(Err(format!("Extraction failed: {}", err))));
                        return;
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupFinished(Err(format!("Failed to run PowerShell: {}", e))));
                        return;
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
                
                let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupProgress(0.7));
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(400));

                // 3. Verify it actually copied
                if !root.join("RustyTools.dll").exists() {
                    let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupFinished(Err("PowerShell ran, but RustyTools.dll was not found in the destination folder. The zip might not contain it.".into())));
                    return;
                }

                let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&temp_dir);
                let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupProgress(0.9));
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(400));

                let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupProgress(1.0));
                let _ = tx.try_send(crate::message::Message::SetupFinished(Ok(())));
            }
        });

        while let Some(msg) = rx.next().await {
            let _ = output.send(msg).await;
        }
    })
}
pub fn remove_rustytools(steam_root: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let dlls = ["RustyTools.dll", "dwmapi.dll", "xinput1_4.dll"];
    let mut failed = false;
    for dll in dlls {
        let path = steam_root.join(dll);
        if path.exists() {
            if std::fs::remove_file(&path).is_err() {
                failed = true;
            }
        }
    }
    if failed {
        Err("Could not delete some DLLs. Make sure Steam is completely closed.".into())
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}

===== FILE: src\backend\steam.rs =====
//! Read-only Steam metadata discovery used only to improve local library names.
//!
//! This module deliberately exposes no mutating Steam filesystem operation.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fs;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::OnceLock;
#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
use std::process::Command;

#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;

use super::keyvalues::{self, Value};

/// Windows flag that prevents a spawned console program from opening a
/// console window. `reg.exe` and other console utilities would otherwise
/// flash a black window every time they run.
#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
pub(crate) const CREATE_NO_WINDOW: u32 = 0x0800_0000;

/// App metadata read from an existing local Steam installation.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub(crate) struct AppInfo {
    /// Display name stored in Steam's local metadata.
    pub name: String,
}

/// Read-only maps that relate installed app IDs and depot IDs to game names.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub(crate) struct SteamMetadata {
    /// Installed apps indexed by their AppID.
    pub apps: HashMap<String, AppInfo>,
    /// Known depot IDs mapped to the installed app that owns them.
    pub depot_owners: HashMap<String, String>,
}

/// Cached result of the first Steam root lookup. The underlying probe
/// spawns `reg.exe` on Windows and walks several conventional paths on
/// Linux. Caching means the probe runs once per process instead of on
/// every library refresh, and it removes the repeated console flashes
/// that used to appear whenever the library was rescanned.
static ROOT_CACHE: OnceLock<Option<PathBuf>> = OnceLock::new();

/// Locates a Steam client folder on supported operating systems.
pub(crate) fn discover_root() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    ROOT_CACHE.get_or_init(discover_root_uncached).clone()
}

fn discover_root_uncached() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
    if let Some(path) = std::env::var_os("STEAM_DIR") {
        candidates.push(PathBuf::from(path));
    }

    #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
    {
        candidates.extend(registry_paths());
        if let Some(path) = std::env::var_os("ProgramFiles(x86)") {
            candidates.push(PathBuf::from(path).join("Steam"));
        }
        if let Some(path) = std::env::var_os("ProgramFiles") {
            candidates.push(PathBuf::from(path).join("Steam"));
        }
    }


    candidates.into_iter().find(|path| is_steam_root(path))
}

/// The directory where Steam loads Lua depot configurations from.
/// This is the folder BetterSteamTools and OpenSteamTool read at start-up.
pub(crate) fn stplug_in_dir(root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    root.join("config").join("stplug-in")
}

/// The directory where Steam looks for depot manifests by filename.
/// Files must be named `<depot_id>_<manifest_gid>.manifest`.
pub(crate) fn depotcache_dir(root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    root.join("depotcache")
}

/// Reads installed app names and depot ownership without modifying Steam files.
pub(crate) fn read_metadata(root: &Path) -> Result<SteamMetadata, String> {
    if !is_steam_root(root) {
        return Err(format!("Not a Steam client directory: {}", root.display()));
    }

    let steamapps = root.join("steamapps");
    let mut steamapps_dirs = vec![steamapps.clone()];
    let library_file = steamapps.join("libraryfolders.vdf");
    if let Ok(source) = fs::read_to_string(library_file) {
        for path in library_paths(&source) {
            let path = path.join("steamapps");
            if path.is_dir() && !contains_path(&steamapps_dirs, &path) {
                steamapps_dirs.push(path);
            }
        }
    }

    let mut metadata = SteamMetadata::default();
    for directory in &steamapps_dirs {
        let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(directory) else {
            continue;
        };
        for entry in entries.flatten() {
            let path = entry.path();
            let Some(filename) = path.file_name().and_then(|name| name.to_str()) else {
                continue;
            };
            if !filename.starts_with("appmanifest_")
                || !filename.ends_with(".acf")
                || !path.is_file()
            {
                continue;
            }
            let Ok(source) = fs::read_to_string(&path) else {
                continue;
            };
            let nodes = keyvalues::parse(&source);
            let app_state = keyvalues::object(&nodes, "AppState").unwrap_or(&nodes);
            let app_id = keyvalues::scalar(app_state, "appid")
                .map(str::to_owned)
                .or_else(|| app_id_from_filename(filename));
            let Some(app_id) = app_id else {
                continue;
            };
            let name = keyvalues::scalar(app_state, "name")
                .filter(|name| !name.trim().is_empty())
                .map(str::to_owned)
                .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("App {app_id}"));
            metadata.apps.insert(app_id.clone(), AppInfo { name });

            if let Some(depots) = keyvalues::object(app_state, "InstalledDepots") {
                for (depot_id, value) in depots {
                    if matches!(value, Value::Object(_))
                        && depot_id.chars().all(|character| character.is_ascii_digit())
                    {
                        metadata.depot_owners.insert(depot_id.clone(), app_id.clone());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(metadata)
}

fn is_steam_root(path: &Path) -> bool {
    path.is_dir() && path.join("steamapps").is_dir()
}

fn contains_path(paths: &[PathBuf], candidate: &Path) -> bool {
    paths.iter().any(|path| {
        let left = path.to_string_lossy();
        let right = candidate.to_string_lossy();
        if cfg!(windows) {
            left.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&right)
        } else {
            left == right
        }
    })
}

fn library_paths(source: &str) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    let nodes = keyvalues::parse(source);
    let libraries = keyvalues::object(&nodes, "libraryfolders").unwrap_or(&nodes);
    let mut paths = Vec::new();
    for (key, value) in libraries {
        if key == "0" || key.chars().all(|character| character.is_ascii_digit()) {
            match value {
                Value::Scalar(path) => paths.push(PathBuf::from(path)),
                Value::Object(fields) => {
                    if let Some(path) = keyvalues::scalar(fields, "path") {
                        paths.push(PathBuf::from(path));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    paths
}

fn app_id_from_filename(filename: &str) -> Option<String> {
    filename
        .strip_prefix("appmanifest_")?
        .strip_suffix(".acf")
        .filter(|id| !id.is_empty() && id.chars().all(|character| character.is_ascii_digit()))
        .map(str::to_owned)
}

#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
fn registry_paths() -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    [
        r"HKCU\Software\Valve\Steam",
        r"HKLM\Software\Wow6432Node\Valve\Steam",
        r"HKLM\Software\Valve\Steam",
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .filter_map(|key| {
        // Suppress the console window that would otherwise flash for
        // every reg.exe invocation.
        let mut command = Command::new("reg");
        command.args(["query", key, "/v", "SteamPath"]);
        command.creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW);
        let output = command.output().ok()?;
        if !output.status.success() {
            return None;
        }
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).lines().find_map(|line| {
            let (_, value) = line.split_once("REG_SZ")?;
            let value = value.trim();
            (!value.is_empty()).then(|| PathBuf::from(value))
        })
    })
    .collect()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::app_id_from_filename;

    #[test]
    fn app_id_is_read_from_standard_appmanifest_name() {
        assert_eq!(app_id_from_filename("appmanifest_12345.acf"), Some("12345".into()));
        assert_eq!(app_id_from_filename("appmanifest_test.acf"), None);
    }
}
