===== FILE: src\message.rs =====
//! The top-level message enum for every user action and filesystem result.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use iced::window;

use crate::state::{StorageKind, View, library_state::ImportOutcome};

/// An event handled by the application update loop.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum Message {
    /// Native window event, including file drops.
    WindowEvent(window::Event),

    /// Minimize the window.
    Minimize,
    /// Toggle maximized window state.
    ToggleMaximize,
    /// Close the window.
    Close,
    /// Begin dragging the frameless window.
    StartDrag,
    /// Resize the frameless window from an edge or corner.
    Resize(window::Direction),

    /// Navigate to a screen.
    Navigate(View),
    /// Expand or collapse advanced options.
    ToggleAdvanced,
    /// Open the contextual storage guide.
    OpenStorageGuide,
    /// Close the contextual storage guide.
    CloseStorageGuide,
    /// Consume clicks on the dimmed guide backdrop without forwarding them to the page.
    StorageGuideBackdropPressed,

    /// Open a multi-select file chooser.
    ChooseFiles,
    /// Result from the native file chooser.
    FilesChosen(Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String>),
    /// Remove a staged path without importing it.
    RemovePending(PathBuf),
    /// Clear the staging list.
    ClearPending,
    /// Copy staged files into the configured local library.
    ImportPending,
    /// Background import result.
    ImportCompleted(ImportOutcome),
    /// Refresh the filesystem-backed library view without a success notification.
    RefreshLibrary,
    /// Result of a quick, local-only library scan.
    LibraryRefreshed(crate::state::library_state::LibrarySnapshot),
    /// Result of background Steam name and cover-art resolution.
    LibraryArtworkRefreshed(crate::state::library_state::LibrarySnapshot),
    /// Expand or collapse one game entry in the library screen.
    ToggleLibraryEntry(String),
    /// A notice timer elapsed; the token prevents clearing a newer notice.
    NoticeExpired(u64),

    /// Ask for confirmation before deleting one library entry.
    RequestRemove(String),
    /// Delete files in a confirmed library entry.
    ConfirmRemove,
    /// Dismiss the remove confirmation.
    CancelRemove,

    /// Update the manifest storage path field.
    ManifestDirChanged(String),
    /// Open a folder picker for manifest storage.
    BrowseManifestDir,
    /// Open a folder picker for Lua storage.
    BrowseLuaDir,
    /// Result from a folder chooser.
    StorageDirectoryChosen(StorageKind, Result<Option<PathBuf>, String>),
    /// Validate and persist both storage folders.
    SaveStoragePaths,

    // --- Options / Config Status Bar ---
    /// User clicked to generate the default rustytools.toml
    CreateDefaultConfig,
    /// Update the draft text for the Lua directory input box
    LuaDirDraftChanged(String),
    /// Save the updated Lua directory to the TOML file
    SaveLuaDir,
    /// Re-read the rustytools.toml file from disk.
    RefreshConfig,
    SetupInstall,
    SetupProgress(f32),
    SetupFinished(Result<(), String>),
    RestartSteam,
    RemoveRustyTools,
}

===== FILE: src\state\library_state.rs =====
//! Types representing the manager's filesystem-backed local library.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use super::FileKind;

/// A supported file stored in one of the configured local library folders.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct LibraryFile {
    /// Full path to the stored copy.
    pub path: PathBuf,
    /// Category inferred from the file extension.
    pub kind: FileKind,
}

/// A group of stored files that appear to belong to the same game.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct LibraryEntry {
    /// Stable key used to address this entry from UI actions.
    pub key: String,
    /// Display name inferred from filenames and, when available, Steam metadata.
    pub name: String,
    /// Whether the name is only a filename-derived fallback that may be replaced by online metadata.
    pub name_is_fallback: bool,
    /// Path to a local or downloaded cover image, if one is available.
    pub cover_path: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// Files stored for this entry.
    pub files: Vec<LibraryFile>,
}

impl LibraryEntry {
    /// Number of manifest files in this entry.
    pub fn manifest_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.files
            .iter()
            .filter(|file| file.kind == FileKind::Manifest)
            .count()
    }

    /// Number of Lua files in this entry.
    pub fn lua_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.files
            .iter()
            .filter(|file| file.kind == FileKind::Lua)
            .count()
    }
}

/// A point-in-time scan of the configured local storage folders.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct LibrarySnapshot {
    /// Grouped library entries, rebuilt from the filesystem on refresh.
    pub entries: Vec<LibraryEntry>,
    /// Error encountered while scanning, if any.
    pub error: Option<String>,
}

/// Summary of a completed import operation.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ImportOutcome {
    /// Library state after the import attempt.
    pub snapshot: LibrarySnapshot,
    /// Files copied successfully.
    pub imported: usize,
    /// Files skipped because they were unsupported, missing, or already present.
    pub skipped: usize,
    /// Errors that explain any partial failure.
    pub errors: Vec<String>,
}


===== FILE: src\state\mod.rs =====
//! Root application state, the navigation enum, and window subscriptions.

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::path::PathBuf;

use iced::Subscription;

use crate::backend::{archive, library};
use crate::message::Message;

pub mod library_state;

/// A screen in the application.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub enum View {
    Setup,
    /// File import and staging.
    #[default]
    Import,
    /// Files already stored in the local library.
    Library,
    /// Storage locations and application settings.
    Options,
    /// Application information.
    About,
}

/// The recognized file categories.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FileKind {
    /// A Steam depot manifest (`.manifest` or `.manifests`).
    Manifest,
    /// A Lua file (`.lua`).
    Lua,
    /// An unsupported file type.
    Unknown,
}

impl FileKind {
    /// Determines a supported kind from a path's extension.
    pub fn from_path(path: &std::path::Path) -> Self {
        match path.extension().and_then(|extension| extension.to_str()) {
            Some(extension)
                if extension.eq_ignore_ascii_case("manifest")
                    || extension.eq_ignore_ascii_case("manifests") =>
            {
                Self::Manifest
            }
            Some(extension) if extension.eq_ignore_ascii_case("lua") => Self::Lua,
            _ => Self::Unknown,
        }
    }

    /// Returns a short label suitable for the UI.
    pub fn label(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Manifest => "manifest",
            Self::Lua => "lua",
            Self::Unknown => "unsupported",
        }
    }
}

/// A source file staged for import into the local library.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PendingFile {
    /// Original path selected by the user or received through drag-and-drop.
    pub path: PathBuf,
    /// File type inferred from the extension.
    pub kind: FileKind,
}

/// The directory setting currently being selected in a native folder dialog.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum StorageKind {
    /// Location for manifest copies.
    Manifest,
    /// Location for Lua copies.
    Lua,
}

/// All mutable application state used by the Elm-style update/view flow.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct State {
    /// Currently visible screen.
    pub active_view: View,
    /// Files awaiting import.
    pub pending_files: Vec<PendingFile>,
    /// Whether the pointer is carrying a file over the window.
    pub is_drag_over: bool,
    /// Whether the advanced options panel is expanded.
    pub advanced_open: bool,
    /// Whether the contextual storage guide dialog is visible.
    pub storage_guide_open: bool,
    pub rustytools_installed: bool,
    pub steam_root: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub setup_progress: Option<f32>,
    pub setup_error: Option<String>,
    pub steam_was_running: bool,

    /// Folder where manifest copies are stored.
    pub manifest_dir: String,
    /// Folder where Lua copies are stored.
    pub lua_dir: String,
    
    // --- Config Editing State ---
    /// Whether the rustytools.toml config file currently exists in the Steam root.
    pub config_exists: bool,
    /// The in-progress text input for the Lua directory.
    pub lua_dir_draft: String,

    /// Snapshot reconstructed from the configured local library folders.
    pub library: library_state::LibrarySnapshot,
    /// A transient status or error message displayed by the UI.
    pub notice: Option<String>,
    /// Entry key awaiting removal confirmation.
    pub confirm_remove: Option<String>,
    /// Prevents starting multiple simultaneous imports.
    pub is_importing: bool,
    /// Prevents overlapping filesystem scans and artwork lookups.
    pub is_refreshing_library: bool,
    /// Schedules one follow-up scan when a change occurs during a refresh.
    pub library_refresh_pending: bool,
    /// Entries whose file lists are expanded in the library screen.
    pub expanded_library_entries: HashSet<String>,
    /// Monotonic token used to prevent old timers dismissing newer notices.
    pub notice_sequence: u64,
}

impl Default for State {
    fn default() -> Self {
        let settings = archive::load_settings();
        let snapshot = library::scan(&settings.manifest_dir, &settings.lua_dir);
        let lua_dir_str = settings.lua_dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
        
        let config_exists = crate::backend::steam::discover_root()
            .map(|root| root.join("rustytools.toml").exists())
            .unwrap_or(false);
        
        let steam_root = crate::backend::steam::discover_root();
        let rustytools_installed = steam_root.as_ref().map_or(false, |r| crate::backend::setup::is_installed(r));
        let active_view = if rustytools_installed { View::Import } else { View::Setup };

        Self {
            active_view,
            rustytools_installed,
            steam_root,
            setup_progress: None,
            setup_error: None,
            steam_was_running: false,
            pending_files: Vec::new(),
            is_drag_over: false,
            advanced_open: false,
            storage_guide_open: false,
            manifest_dir: settings.manifest_dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            lua_dir: lua_dir_str.clone(),
            
            config_exists,
            lua_dir_draft: lua_dir_str,

            library: snapshot,
            notice: None,
            confirm_remove: None,
            is_importing: false,
            is_refreshing_library: false,
            library_refresh_pending: false,
            expanded_library_entries: HashSet::new(),
            notice_sequence: 0,
        }
    }
}

impl State {
    /// Subscribes to native window events, including file drag-and-drop.
    pub fn subscription(&self) -> Subscription<Message> {
        iced::window::events().map(|(_id, event)| Message::WindowEvent(event))
    }

    /// Adds valid and unsupported drops to the staging list without duplicating paths.
    pub fn stage_paths(&mut self, paths: impl IntoIterator<Item = PathBuf>) {
        for path in paths {
            let already_staged = self.pending_files.iter().any(|file| {
                file.path == path
                    || file
                        .path
                        .canonicalize()
                        .ok()
                        .zip(path.canonicalize().ok())
                        .is_some_and(|(left, right)| left == right)
            });
            if !already_staged {
                self.pending_files.push(PendingFile {
                    kind: FileKind::from_path(&path),
                    path,
                });
            }
        }
    }
}

===== FILE: src\theme.rs =====
//! Every color, every metric, and the single theme constructor.
//! Nothing outside this file may hardcode a color. See AGENTS.md section 4.

use std::sync::Arc;

use iced::theme::{Custom, Palette};
use iced::{Color, Theme};

// --- Surfaces ---------------------------------------------------------------

pub const BG_BASE: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.055, 0.055, 0.055); // #0E0E0E
pub const BG_SURFACE: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.078, 0.078, 0.078); // #141414
pub const BG_ELEVATED: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.102, 0.102, 0.102); // #1A1A1A
pub const BG_HOVER: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.125, 0.125, 0.125); // #202020
pub const MODAL_BACKDROP: Color = Color::from_rgba(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.82);

// --- Lines ------------------------------------------------------------------

pub const BORDER: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.145, 0.145, 0.145); // #252525
pub const BORDER_SUBTLE: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.110, 0.110, 0.110); // #1C1C1C

/// Horizontal rule colour. Same value as BORDER_SUBTLE but named for
/// intent so call sites read clearly.
pub const SEPARATOR: Color = BORDER_SUBTLE;

// --- Text -------------------------------------------------------------------

pub const TEXT_PRIMARY: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.867, 0.867, 0.867); // #DDDDDD
pub const TEXT_SECONDARY: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.533, 0.533, 0.533); // #888888
pub const TEXT_MUTED: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.333, 0.333, 0.333); // #555555

// --- Semantic ---------------------------------------------------------------

pub const ACCENT: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.867, 0.867, 0.867); // #DDDDDD
pub const SUCCESS: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.220, 0.557, 0.235); // #388E3C
pub const DANGER: Color = Color::from_rgb(0.706, 0.243, 0.208); // #B43E35

// --- Metrics ----------------------------------------------------------------

pub const TITLEBAR_HEIGHT: f32 = 40.0;
pub const SIDEBAR_WIDTH: f32 = 200.0;
pub const CORNER_RADIUS: f32 = 8.0;
pub const RESIZE_BORDER: f32 = 6.0;

pub const SIDEBAR_LIBRARY_OFFSET: f32 = 12.0;

/// Font size for the Lucide glyphs in the sidebar.
pub const NAV_ICON_SIZE: f32 = 20.0;

/// Horizontal space reserved for a nav icon.
pub const NAV_ICON_SLOT: f32 = 24.0;

/// Font size for the Lucide glyphs in the titlebar.
pub const TITLEBAR_ICON_SIZE: f32 = 16.0;

/// Rendered size of the brand mark in the titlebar.
pub const BRAND_ICON_SIZE: f32 = 18.0;

// --- Theme ------------------------------------------------------------------

pub fn app_theme() -> Theme {
    let palette = Palette {
        background: BG_BASE,
        text: TEXT_PRIMARY,
        primary: ACCENT,
        success: SUCCESS,
        warning: TEXT_SECONDARY,
        danger: DANGER,
    };

    Theme::Custom(Arc::new(Custom::new("Locomotive".to_string(), palette)))
}

===== FILE: src\update\mod.rs =====
//! Routes UI messages, starts background work, and keeps transient UI state tidy.

pub mod window;

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::time::Duration;

use iced::window as iced_window;
use iced::Task;

use crate::backend::{archive, file_dialog, importer, library};
use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::{State, StorageKind, View};

fn with_window(
    f: impl FnOnce(iced_window::Id) -> Task<Message> + Send + 'static,
) -> Task<Message> {
    let mut f = Some(f);
    iced_window::latest().then(move |id| {
        let Some(f) = f.take() else {
            return Task::none();
        };
        match id {
            Some(id) => f(id),
            None => Task::none(),
        }
    })
}

/// Applies one UI message and returns any asynchronous work it requested.
pub fn handle(state: &mut State, message: Message) -> Task<Message> {
    match message {
        Message::Minimize => with_window(|id| iced_window::minimize(id, true)),
        Message::ToggleMaximize => with_window(iced_window::toggle_maximize),
        Message::Close => with_window(iced_window::close),
        Message::StartDrag => with_window(iced_window::drag),
        Message::Resize(direction) => with_window(move |id| iced_window::drag_resize(id, direction)),
        Message::WindowEvent(event) => window::handle_event(state, event),
        Message::Navigate(view) => {
            state.active_view = view;
            if view == View::Library && !state.is_refreshing_library {
                start_library_refresh(state)
            } else if view == View::Options {
                Task::done(Message::RefreshConfig)
            } else {
                Task::none()
            }
        }
        Message::ToggleAdvanced => {
            state.advanced_open = !state.advanced_open;
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::OpenStorageGuide => {
            state.storage_guide_open = true;
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::CloseStorageGuide => {
            state.storage_guide_open = false;
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::StorageGuideBackdropPressed => Task::none(),
        Message::ChooseFiles => Task::perform(async { file_dialog::choose_files() }, Message::FilesChosen),
        Message::FilesChosen(result) => match result {
            Ok(paths) => {
                if paths.is_empty() {
                    Task::none()
                } else {
                    state.stage_paths(paths);
                    show_notice(state, "Files staged. Select Import to copy them into the local library.")
                }
            }
            Err(error) => show_notice(state, error),
        },
        Message::RemovePending(path) => {
            state.pending_files.retain(|file| file.path != path);
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::ClearPending => {
            state.pending_files.clear();
            clear_notice(state);
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::ImportPending => {
            if state.is_importing {
                return Task::none();
            }
            if !state.pending_files.iter().any(|file| file.kind != crate::state::FileKind::Unknown) {
                return show_notice(
                    state,
                    "Choose or drop at least one .manifest, .manifests, or .lua file first.",
                );
            }

            let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(&state.manifest_dir);
            let lua_dir = PathBuf::from(&state.lua_dir);
            let files = state.pending_files.clone();
            state.is_importing = true;
            let notice_task = show_notice(state, "Importing files into the local library…");
            let import_task = Task::perform(
                async move { importer::import_files(&manifest_dir, &lua_dir, &files) },
                Message::ImportCompleted,
            );
            Task::batch([notice_task, import_task])
        }
        Message::ImportCompleted(outcome) => {
            state.is_importing = false;
            state.library = outcome.snapshot;
            state.pending_files.clear();

            let mut details = Vec::new();
            if outcome.imported > 0 {
                details.push(format!("Added {} file(s)", outcome.imported));
            }
            if outcome.skipped > 0 {
                details.push(format!("skipped {} file(s)", outcome.skipped));
            }
            if !outcome.errors.is_empty() {
                details.push(outcome.errors.join(" · "));
            }
            let notice = if details.is_empty() {
                "No new files were added.".to_owned()
            } else {
                details.join(" — ")
            };
            let notice_task = show_notice(state, notice);
            let refresh_task = start_library_refresh(state);
            Task::batch([notice_task, refresh_task])
        }
        Message::RefreshLibrary => start_library_refresh(state),
        Message::LibraryRefreshed(snapshot) => {
            state.library = snapshot.clone();
            let artwork_task = Task::perform(
                async move {
                    let mut snapshot = snapshot;
                    crate::backend::artwork::enrich_remote(&mut snapshot);
                    snapshot
                },
                Message::LibraryArtworkRefreshed,
            );
            retain_expanded_entries(state);
            artwork_task
        }
        Message::LibraryArtworkRefreshed(snapshot) => {
            state.library = snapshot;
            state.is_refreshing_library = false;
            retain_expanded_entries(state);
            if state.library_refresh_pending {
                state.library_refresh_pending = false;
                start_library_refresh(state)
            } else {
                Task::none()
            }
        }
        Message::ToggleLibraryEntry(key) => {
            if !state.expanded_library_entries.remove(&key) {
                state.expanded_library_entries.insert(key);
            }
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::NoticeExpired(token) => {
            if token == state.notice_sequence {
                state.notice = None;
            }
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::RequestRemove(key) => {
            state.confirm_remove = Some(key);
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::ConfirmRemove => {
            let Some(key) = state.confirm_remove.take() else {
                return Task::none();
            };
            let Some(entry) = state.library.entries.iter().find(|entry| entry.key == key).cloned() else {
                return show_notice(state, "That library entry is no longer available. Refresh and try again.");
            };

            match importer::remove_entry(
                &PathBuf::from(&state.manifest_dir),
                &PathBuf::from(&state.lua_dir),
                &entry,
            ) {
                Ok(removed) => {
                    let notice_task = show_notice(
                        state,
                        format!("Removed {removed} local file(s). The installed game files were not changed."),
                    );
                    let refresh_task = start_library_refresh(state);
                    Task::batch([notice_task, refresh_task])
                }
                Err(error) => show_notice(state, error),
            }
        }
        Message::CancelRemove => {
            state.confirm_remove = None;
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::ManifestDirChanged(path) => {
            state.manifest_dir = path;
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::BrowseManifestDir => choose_storage_dir(StorageKind::Manifest),
        Message::BrowseLuaDir => choose_storage_dir(StorageKind::Lua),
        Message::StorageDirectoryChosen(kind, result) => match result {
            Ok(Some(path)) => {
                match kind {
                    StorageKind::Manifest => state.manifest_dir = path.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                    StorageKind::Lua => state.lua_dir = path.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
                }
                Task::none()
            }
            Ok(None) => Task::none(),
            Err(error) => show_notice(state, error),
        },
        Message::SaveStoragePaths => match archive::save_settings(
            &PathBuf::from(state.manifest_dir.trim()),
            &PathBuf::from(state.lua_dir.trim()),
        ) {
            Ok(settings) => {
                state.manifest_dir = settings.manifest_dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                state.lua_dir = settings.lua_dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                let notice_task = show_notice(
                    state,
                    "Storage folders saved. Existing files stay in their current locations.",
                );
                let refresh_task = start_library_refresh(state);
                Task::batch([notice_task, refresh_task])
            }
            Err(error) => show_notice(state, error),
        },
        // --- Options / Config Status Bar ---
        Message::LuaDirDraftChanged(path) => {
            state.lua_dir_draft = path;
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::CreateDefaultConfig => {
            let Some(root) = crate::backend::steam::discover_root() else {
                return show_notice(state, "Could not find Steam root. Make sure Steam is installed.");
            };
            let config_path = root.join("rustytools.toml");
            let default_toml = r#"# rustytools.toml - rusty_tools configuration
# Place at: <Steam>/rustytools.toml
# Loaded at startup; hot-reloaded on changes.

[log]
# Per-module log level. Valid: trace, debug, info, warn, error
level = "debug"

[manifest]
url = "opensteamtool"
timeout_resolve_ms = 5000
timeout_connect_ms = 5000
timeout_send_ms    = 10000
timeout_recv_ms    = 10000

[donate]
enabled = true

[stats]
enable_api = true

[update]
enabled = false

[lua]
# paths = ["D:/my-steam-config/lua"]

[tokeer]
register_scheme = false

[remote]
# url_template = "https://your.server/{channel}/{component}/{sha256}.toml"
"#;
            if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&config_path, default_toml) {
                return show_notice(state, format!("Failed to create config: {}", e));
            }
            state.config_exists = true;
            show_notice(state, "Created rustytools.toml successfully.")
        }
        Message::SetupInstall => {
            if let Some(root) = &state.steam_root {
                state.setup_progress = Some(0.0);
                state.setup_error = None;
                Task::stream(crate::backend::setup::download_and_install(root.clone()))
            } else {
                Task::none()
            }
        }
        Message::SetupProgress(p) => {
            state.setup_progress = Some(p);
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::SetupFinished(res) => {
            match res {
                Ok(_) => {
                    state.rustytools_installed = true;
                    state.setup_progress = Some(1.0);
                    state.steam_was_running = crate::backend::setup::is_steam_running();
                    Task::none()
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    state.setup_error = Some(e);
                    state.setup_progress = None;
                    Task::none()
                }
            }
        }
        Message::RestartSteam => {
            crate::backend::setup::restart_steam();
            state.active_view = View::Import;
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::RemoveRustyTools => {
            if let Some(root) = &state.steam_root {
                if crate::backend::setup::is_steam_running() {
                    return show_notice(state, "Please close Steam before removing RustyTools.");
                }
                
                match crate::backend::setup::remove_rustytools(root) {
                    Ok(_) => {
                        state.rustytools_installed = false;
                        show_notice(state, "RustyTools has been removed from your Steam directory.")
                    }
                    Err(e) => show_notice(state, e),
                }
            } else {
                Task::none()
            }
        }
        Message::RefreshConfig => {
            let Some(root) = crate::backend::steam::discover_root() else {
                return Task::none();
            };
            let config_path = root.join("rustytools.toml");
            state.config_exists = config_path.exists();
            
            if state.config_exists {
                if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&config_path) {
                    let mut in_lua = false;
                    let mut new_lua_dir = None;
                    
                    for line in content.lines() {
                        let trimmed = line.trim();
                        if trimmed.starts_with('[') && trimmed.ends_with(']') {
                            in_lua = trimmed == "[lua]";
                        } else if in_lua && trimmed.starts_with("dir") {
                            if let Some(eq) = trimmed.find('=') {
                                let val = trimmed[eq + 1..].trim().trim_matches('"').replace("\\\\", "\\");
                                if !val.is_empty() {
                                    new_lua_dir = Some(val);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if let Some(dir) = new_lua_dir {
                        state.lua_dir = dir.clone();
                        state.lua_dir_draft = dir;
                    } else {
                        state.lua_dir = format!("{}\\config\\stplug-in", root.display());
                        state.lua_dir_draft = state.lua_dir.clone();
                    }
                }
            }
            Task::none()
        }
        Message::SaveLuaDir => {
            let Some(root) = crate::backend::steam::discover_root() else {
                return show_notice(state, "Could not find Steam root.");
            };
            let config_path = root.join("rustytools.toml");
            
            let toml_str = match std::fs::read_to_string(&config_path) {
                Ok(s) => s,
                Err(e) => return show_notice(state, format!("Failed to read config: {}", e)),
            };

            let draft = state.lua_dir_draft.trim();
            
            let lines: Vec<&str> = toml_str.lines().collect();
            let mut new_lines = Vec::new();
            let mut in_lua_section = false;
            let mut found_dir = false;

            for line in lines {
                let trimmed = line.trim();
                if trimmed == "[lua]" {
                    in_lua_section = true;
                    new_lines.push(line.to_string());
                } else if trimmed.starts_with('[') && trimmed.ends_with(']') {
                    in_lua_section = false;
                    new_lines.push(line.to_string());
                } else if in_lua_section && trimmed.starts_with("dir") {
                    if !draft.is_empty() {
                        new_lines.push(format!("dir = \"{}\"", draft.replace("\\", "\\\\")));
                    }
                    found_dir = true;
                } else {
                    new_lines.push(line.to_string());
                }
            }

            if !found_dir && !draft.is_empty() {
                let mut has_lua = false;
                for line in &new_lines {
                    if line.trim() == "[lua]" {
                        has_lua = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if !has_lua {
                    new_lines.push("[lua]".to_string());
                }
                
                let mut insert_idx = new_lines.len();
                for (i, line) in new_lines.iter().enumerate() {
                    if line.trim() == "[lua]" {
                        insert_idx = i + 1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                new_lines.insert(insert_idx, format!("dir = \"{}\"", draft.replace("\\", "\\\\")));
            }

            let mut result = new_lines.join("\n");
            if !result.ends_with('\n') {
                result.push('\n');
            }

            if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&config_path, result) {
                return show_notice(state, format!("Failed to save config: {}", e));
            }
            
            state.lua_dir = draft.to_string();
            show_notice(state, "Lua directory updated.")
        }
    }
}

fn retain_expanded_entries(state: &mut State) {
    let current_keys: HashSet<String> = state
        .library
        .entries
        .iter()
        .map(|entry| entry.key.clone())
        .collect();
    state
        .expanded_library_entries
        .retain(|key| current_keys.contains(key));
}

fn start_library_refresh(state: &mut State) -> Task<Message> {
    if state.is_refreshing_library {
        state.library_refresh_pending = true;
        return Task::none();
    }

    let settings = match archive::normalize_and_validate(
        PathBuf::from(state.manifest_dir.trim()),
        PathBuf::from(state.lua_dir.trim()),
    ) {
        Ok(settings) => settings,
        Err(error) => return show_notice(state, error),
    };

    state.manifest_dir = settings.manifest_dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
    state.lua_dir = settings.lua_dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
    state.is_refreshing_library = true;

    let manifest_dir = settings.manifest_dir;
    let lua_dir = settings.lua_dir;
    Task::perform(
        async move { library::refresh(&manifest_dir, &lua_dir) },
        Message::LibraryRefreshed,
    )
}

fn show_notice(state: &mut State, notice: impl Into<String>) -> Task<Message> {
    state.notice_sequence = state.notice_sequence.wrapping_add(1);
    let token = state.notice_sequence;
    state.notice = Some(notice.into());

    Task::perform(
        async move {
            let (sender, receiver) = iced::futures::channel::oneshot::channel();
            let timer = std::thread::Builder::new()
                .name("locomotive-notice-timer".to_owned())
                .spawn(move || {
                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(5));
                    let _ = sender.send(token);
                });
            if timer.is_err() {
                return token;
            }
            receiver.await.unwrap_or(token)
        },
        Message::NoticeExpired,
    )
}

fn clear_notice(state: &mut State) {
    state.notice_sequence = state.notice_sequence.wrapping_add(1);
    state.notice = None;
}

fn choose_storage_dir(kind: StorageKind) -> Task<Message> {
    Task::perform(async { file_dialog::choose_directory() }, move |result| {
        Message::StorageDirectoryChosen(kind, result)
    })
}

===== FILE: src\update\window.rs =====
//! Native window event handling, including drag-and-drop staging.

use iced::Task;
use iced::window as iced_window;

use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::{State, View};

/// Handles window events and stages dropped paths for review.
pub fn handle_event(state: &mut State, event: iced_window::Event) -> Task<Message> {
    match event {
        iced_window::Event::FileDropped(path) => {
            state.stage_paths([path]);
            state.is_drag_over = false;
            state.active_view = View::Import;
            Task::none()
        }
        iced_window::Event::FileHovered(_) => {
            state.is_drag_over = true;
            Task::none()
        }
        iced_window::Event::FilesHoveredLeft => {
            state.is_drag_over = false;
            Task::none()
        }
        iced_window::Event::CloseRequested => {
            let mut done = false;
            iced_window::latest().then(move |id| {
                if done {
                    return Task::none();
                }
                done = true;
                match id {
                    Some(id) => iced_window::close(id),
                    None => Task::none(),
                }
            })
        }
        _ => Task::none(),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use std::path::PathBuf;

    use crate::state::FileKind;

    #[test]
    fn both_manifest_extensions_are_classified() {
        assert_eq!(FileKind::from_path(&PathBuf::from("/tmp/12345_67890.manifest")), FileKind::Manifest);
        assert_eq!(FileKind::from_path(&PathBuf::from("/tmp/12345_67890.manifests")), FileKind::Manifest);
    }

    #[test]
    fn lua_is_classified_case_insensitively() {
        assert_eq!(FileKind::from_path(&PathBuf::from("C:/drops/App.LUA")), FileKind::Lua);
    }

    #[test]
    fn unrelated_extensions_are_not_imported() {
        assert_eq!(FileKind::from_path(&PathBuf::from("readme.txt")), FileKind::Unknown);
    }
}
