//! About panel. Shows the application name, version, and a short
//! description of what the tool does.

use iced::widget::{column, row, text, Space};
use iced::{Alignment, Element, Length};

use crate::app::{APP_NAME, APP_VERSION};
use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::State;
use crate::theme;
use crate::views::components;

/// Renders application details and build information.
pub fn view(_state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    let header = column![
        components::page_header(APP_NAME, 20.0),
        text(format!("Version {}", APP_VERSION))
            .size(12)
            .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
    ]
    .spacing(7);

    let description = components::card(
        column![
            text("About").size(13).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
            components::separator(),
            Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(6.0)),
            text(
                "Locomotive is a cross-platform file manager for Steam depot \
                 manifests and Lua files. Import or drop files into the \
                 configured storage folders, browse grouped entries, and remove \
                 only the manifest and Lua files represented by an entry. It \
                 does not uninstall games or change account entitlements."
                    .to_string(),
            )
            .size(12)
            .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
        ]
        .spacing(0),
    );

    let build_info = components::card(
        column![
            info_row("Version", APP_VERSION),
            Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(8.0)),
            info_row("Channel", "Alpha"),
            Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(8.0)),
            info_row("Toolkit", "Iced 0.14"),
            Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(8.0)),
            info_row("Renderer", "tiny-skia (CPU)"),
            Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(8.0)),
            info_row("Language", "Rust (edition 2024)"),
        ]
        .spacing(0),
    );

    column![
        header,
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(24.0)),
        description,
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(12.0)),
        build_info,
        Space::new().height(Length::Fill),
    ]
    .into()
}

/// One label/value pair inside the build info card.
fn info_row(label: &'static str, value: &str) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    row![
        text(label)
            .size(12)
            .color(theme::TEXT_MUTED)
            .width(Length::Fixed(90.0)),
        text(value.to_string()).size(12).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
    ]
    .align_y(Alignment::Center)
    .into()
}

===== FILE: src\views\components.rs =====
//! Small, reusable widgets. Anything used on more than one screen belongs
//! here rather than being duplicated into a view module.

use iced::widget::{button, container, mouse_area, row, svg, text, Space};
use iced::window::Direction;
use iced::{Alignment, Border, Color, Element, Length, Padding, Theme};

use crate::assets;
use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::View;
use crate::theme;

/// An invisible hit area that starts a native window resize when pressed.
pub fn resize_zone(
    direction: Direction,
    width: Length,
    height: Length,
) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    mouse_area(Space::new().width(width).height(height))
        .on_press(Message::Resize(direction))
        .into()
}

/// A one-pixel horizontal rule.
pub fn separator() -> Element<'static, Message> {
    container(Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(1.0)))
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .style(|_theme| container::Style {
            background: Some(theme::SEPARATOR.into()),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .into()
}

/// A window control in the titlebar.
pub fn titlebar_button(
    glyph: Element<'static, Message>,
    message: Message,
    danger: bool,
    round_top_right: bool,
) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    button(
        container(glyph)
            .center_x(Length::Fill)
            .center_y(Length::Fill),
    )
    .width(Length::Fixed(46.0))
    .height(Length::Fixed(theme::TITLEBAR_HEIGHT))
    .padding(0)
    .on_press(message)
    .style(move |_theme: &Theme, status| {
        let hover = if danger { theme::DANGER } else { theme::BG_HOVER };
        let background = match status {
            button::Status::Hovered => hover,
            button::Status::Pressed => theme::BG_HOVER,
            _ => Color::TRANSPARENT,
        };
        button::Style {
            background: Some(background.into()),
            text_color: theme::TEXT_PRIMARY,
            border: Border {
                color: Color::TRANSPARENT,
                width: 0.0,
                radius: iced::border::Radius {
                    top_left: 0.0,
                    top_right: if round_top_right { theme::CORNER_RADIUS } else { 0.0 },
                    bottom_left: 0.0,
                    bottom_right: 0.0,
                },
            },
            ..button::Style::default()
        }
    })
    .into()
}

/// A sidebar navigation item with a Lucide icon on the left.
pub fn nav_button(
    icon: Element<'static, Message>,
    label: &'static str,
    view: View,
    active: bool,
) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    let color = if active {
        theme::TEXT_PRIMARY
    } else {
        theme::TEXT_SECONDARY
    };

    button(
        row![
            container(icon)
                .width(Length::Fixed(theme::NAV_ICON_SLOT))
                .align_y(Alignment::Center),
            text(label).size(13).color(color),
        ]
        .spacing(10)
        .align_y(Alignment::Center),
    )
    .width(Length::Fill)
    .padding(Padding {
        top: 8.0,
        right: 12.0,
        bottom: 8.0,
        left: 10.0,
    })
    .on_press(Message::Navigate(view))
    .style(move |_theme: &Theme, status| {
        let background = if active {
            theme::BG_ELEVATED
        } else {
            match status {
                button::Status::Hovered => theme::BG_SURFACE,
                _ => Color::TRANSPARENT,
            }
        };
        button::Style {
            background: Some(background.into()),
            text_color: color,
            border: Border {
                color: Color::TRANSPARENT,
                width: 0.0,
                radius: theme::CORNER_RADIUS.into(),
            },
            ..button::Style::default()
        }
    })
    .into()
}


/// A consistent page title and divider. The subtitle belongs immediately below this block.
pub fn page_header(title: &'static str, size: f32) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    iced::widget::column![
        text(title).size(size).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
        separator(),
    ]
    .spacing(10)
    .into()
}

/// A small all-caps label used to separate groups in the sidebar.
pub fn section_label(label: &'static str) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    container(text(label).size(10).color(theme::TEXT_MUTED))
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: 0.0,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: 10.0,
        })
        .into()
}

/// A destructive action. Muted at rest, red only on hover.
pub fn danger_button(label: &'static str, message: Message) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    button(text(label).size(12))
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 6.0,
            right: 14.0,
            bottom: 6.0,
            left: 14.0,
        })
        .on_press(message)
        .style(|_theme: &Theme, status| {
            let hovered = matches!(status, button::Status::Hovered);
            button::Style {
                background: Some(
                    if hovered { theme::DANGER } else { theme::BG_SURFACE }.into(),
                ),
                text_color: if hovered {
                    theme::TEXT_PRIMARY
                } else {
                    theme::TEXT_MUTED
                },
                border: Border {
                    color: if hovered { theme::DANGER } else { theme::BORDER },
                    width: 1.0,
                    radius: theme::CORNER_RADIUS.into(),
                },
                ..button::Style::default()
            }
        })
        .into()
}


/// A compact square help control for contextual guidance that should stay out of the way.
pub fn help_button(message: Message) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    button(
        container(
            text("?")
                .size(14)
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .height(Length::Fill)
                .center(),
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .center_x(Length::Fill)
        .center_y(Length::Fill),
    )
        .width(Length::Fixed(30.0))
        .height(Length::Fixed(30.0))
        .padding(0)
        .on_press(message)
        .style(|_theme: &Theme, status| {
            let hovered = matches!(status, button::Status::Hovered);
            button::Style {
                background: Some((if hovered { theme::BG_HOVER } else { theme::BG_SURFACE }).into()),
                text_color: theme::TEXT_PRIMARY,
                border: Border {
                    color: if hovered { theme::TEXT_SECONDARY } else { theme::BORDER },
                    width: 1.0,
                    radius: 5.0.into(),
                },
                ..button::Style::default()
            }
        })
        .into()
}

/// A standard action button with the existing monochrome interaction styling.
pub fn action_button(label: &'static str, message: Message) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    button(text(label).size(12))
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 7.0,
            right: 14.0,
            bottom: 7.0,
            left: 14.0,
        })
        .on_press(message)
        .style(|_theme: &Theme, status| {
            let hovered = matches!(status, button::Status::Hovered);
            button::Style {
                background: Some((if hovered { theme::BG_HOVER } else { theme::BG_SURFACE }).into()),
                text_color: theme::TEXT_PRIMARY,
                border: Border {
                    color: if hovered { theme::TEXT_SECONDARY } else { theme::BORDER },
                    width: 1.0,
                    radius: theme::CORNER_RADIUS.into(),
                },
                ..button::Style::default()
            }
        })
        .into()
}

/// A high-contrast action button used for the primary action on a screen.
pub fn primary_button(label: &'static str, message: Message) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    button(text(label).size(12))
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 7.0,
            right: 16.0,
            bottom: 7.0,
            left: 16.0,
        })
        .on_press(message)
        .style(|_theme: &Theme, status| {
            let hovered = matches!(status, button::Status::Hovered);
            button::Style {
                background: Some((if hovered { theme::TEXT_PRIMARY } else { theme::ACCENT }).into()),
                text_color: theme::BG_BASE,
                border: Border {
                    color: theme::ACCENT,
                    width: 1.0,
                    radius: theme::CORNER_RADIUS.into(),
                },
                ..button::Style::default()
            }
        })
        .into()
}

/// A primary action with a predictable width, useful in modal footers.
pub fn primary_button_sized(
    label: &'static str,
    message: Message,
    width: f32,
    height: f32,
) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    button(
        container(text(label).size(12))
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .center_x(Length::Fill)
            .center_y(Length::Fill),
    )
    .width(Length::Fixed(width))
    .height(Length::Fixed(height))
    .padding(0)
    .on_press(message)
    .style(|_theme: &Theme, status| {
        let hovered = matches!(status, button::Status::Hovered);
        button::Style {
            background: Some((if hovered { theme::TEXT_PRIMARY } else { theme::ACCENT }).into()),
            text_color: theme::BG_BASE,
            border: Border {
                color: theme::ACCENT,
                width: 1.0,
                radius: theme::CORNER_RADIUS.into(),
            },
            ..button::Style::default()
        }
    })
    .into()
}

/// A bordered panel used to group related controls.
pub fn card<'a>(content: impl Into<Element<'a, Message>>) -> Element<'a, Message> {
    container(content)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .padding(16)
        .style(|_theme| container::Style {
            background: Some(theme::BG_SURFACE.into()),
            border: Border {
                color: theme::BORDER,
                width: 1.0,
                radius: theme::CORNER_RADIUS.into(),
            },
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .into()
}

/// A label on the left and an on/off control on the right.
pub fn toggle_row(
    label: &'static str,
    description: &'static str,
    value: bool,
    message: Message,
) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    let text_block = iced::widget::column![
        text(label).size(13).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
        text(description).size(11).color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
    ]
    .spacing(2);

    let state_label = if value { "On" } else { "Off" };

    let toggle: Element<'static, Message> = button(text(state_label).size(11))
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 4.0,
            right: 14.0,
            bottom: 4.0,
            left: 14.0,
        })
        .on_press(message)
        .style(move |_theme: &Theme, status| {
            let hovered = matches!(status, button::Status::Hovered);
            let background = if value {
                theme::SUCCESS
            } else if hovered {
                theme::BG_HOVER
            } else {
                theme::BG_SURFACE
            };
            let border_color = if value { theme::SUCCESS } else { theme::BORDER };
            button::Style {
                background: Some(background.into()),
                text_color: if value || hovered {
                    theme::TEXT_PRIMARY
                } else {
                    theme::TEXT_MUTED
                },
                border: Border {
                    color: border_color,
                    width: 1.0,
                    radius: 4.0.into(),
                },
                ..button::Style::default()
            }
        })
        .into();

    row![text_block, Space::new().width(Length::Fill), toggle]
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .into()
}

/// The brand mark in the titlebar, loaded from `assets/icon.svg`.
pub fn brand_icon() -> Element<'static, Message> {
    svg(assets::brand_handle())
        .width(Length::Fixed(theme::BRAND_ICON_SIZE))
        .height(Length::Fixed(theme::BRAND_ICON_SIZE))
        .into()
}

===== FILE: src\views\dropzone.rs =====
//! File import screen with native selection, drag-and-drop and a staged-file queue.

use iced::widget::{column, container, row, scrollable, text, Space};
use iced::{Alignment, Border, Element, Length, Padding};

use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::{FileKind, State};
use crate::theme;
use crate::views::components;

/// Renders the import workflow.
pub fn view(state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    let hint = if state.is_drag_over {
        "Release to add files"
    } else {
        "Drop .manifest, .manifests, and .lua files here"
    };
    let zone = container(
        column![
            text(hint).size(16).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
            text("Files are copied into the local library folders configured in Options.")
                .size(12)
                .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
            Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(4.0)),
            components::action_button("Choose files", Message::ChooseFiles),
        ]
        .spacing(8)
        .align_x(Alignment::Center),
    )
    .width(Length::Fill)
    .height(Length::Fixed(170.0))
    .center_x(Length::Fill)
    .center_y(Length::Fill)
    .style(move |_theme| {
        let fill = if state.is_drag_over { theme::BG_HOVER } else { theme::BG_SURFACE };
        let border_color = if state.is_drag_over { theme::TEXT_PRIMARY } else { theme::BORDER };
        container::Style {
            background: Some(fill.into()),
            border: Border {
                color: border_color,
                width: if state.is_drag_over { 2.0 } else { 1.0 },
                radius: 12.0.into(),
            },
            ..Default::default()
        }
    });

    let header = components::page_header("Import files", 20.0);

    let mut body = column![
        header,
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(7.0)),
        text("Stage files, check their types, then copy them into your local library.")
            .size(12)
            .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(20.0)),
        zone,
    ]
    .spacing(0)
    .width(Length::Fill);

    if let Some(notice) = &state.notice {
        body = body
            .push(Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(12.0)))
            .push(text(notice.clone()).size(11).color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY));
    }

    if !state.pending_files.is_empty() {
        let actions = row![
            components::primary_button(
                if state.is_importing { "Importing…" } else { "Import to library" },
                Message::ImportPending,
            ),
            components::action_button("Clear list", Message::ClearPending),
        ]
        .spacing(8)
        .align_y(Alignment::Center);
        body = body
            .push(Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(18.0)))
            .push(row![
                text(format!("Staged files ({})", state.pending_files.len()))
                    .size(12)
                    .color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
                Space::new().width(Length::Fill),
                actions,
            ].align_y(Alignment::Center))
            .push(Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(6.0)))
            .push(components::separator())
            .push(Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(8.0)))
            .push(scrollable(
                container(pending_list(state))
                    .width(Length::Fill)
                    .padding(Padding { top: 0.0, right: 18.0, bottom: 0.0, left: 0.0 }),
            ).width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill));
    }

    body.into()
}

fn pending_list(state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    let mut list = column![].spacing(6);
    for file in &state.pending_files {
        let name = file
            .path
            .file_name()
            .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
            .unwrap_or("<unnamed>");
        let kind_color = if file.kind == FileKind::Unknown {
            theme::TEXT_SECONDARY
        } else {
            theme::TEXT_MUTED
        };
        list = list.push(
            container(
                row![
                    column![
                        text(name.to_owned()).size(12).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
                        text(file.path.parent().map(|path| path.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).unwrap_or_default())
                            .size(10)
                            .color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
                    ]
                    .spacing(2)
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                    text(file.kind.label()).size(10).color(kind_color),
                    components::action_button("Remove", Message::RemovePending(file.path.clone())),
                ]
                .spacing(10)
                .align_y(Alignment::Center),
            )
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .padding(Padding { top: 8.0, right: 10.0, bottom: 8.0, left: 12.0 })
            .style(|_theme| container::Style {
                background: Some(theme::BG_SURFACE.into()),
                border: Border { color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE, width: 1.0, radius: 6.0.into() },
                ..Default::default()
            }),
        );
    }
    list.into()
}


===== FILE: src\views\library.rs =====
//! Compact game cards with progressive disclosure for stored manifests and Lua files.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};

use iced::widget::{column, container, image, row, scrollable, text, Space};
use iced::{Alignment, Border, Element, Length, Padding};

use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::{State, library_state::LibraryEntry};
use crate::theme;
use crate::views::components;

static COVER_HANDLES: OnceLock<Mutex<HashMap<(std::path::PathBuf, u32, u32), image::Handle>>> = OnceLock::new();

/// Renders the local library and its removal confirmation states.
pub fn view(state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    let header = components::page_header("Library", 20.0);

    let mut body = column![
        header,
        text("Browse games and expand a card to inspect its stored files.")
            .size(12)
            .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
        container(
            row![
                text(format!("{} games", state.library.entries.len()))
                    .size(11)
                    .color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
                Space::new().width(Length::Fill),
                components::action_button("Refresh", Message::RefreshLibrary),
            ]
            .align_y(Alignment::Center),
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding { top: 0.0, right: 18.0, bottom: 0.0, left: 0.0 }),
    ]
    .spacing(7);

    if let Some(error) = &state.library.error {
        body = body.push(text(error.clone()).size(11).color(theme::DANGER));
    }
    if let Some(notice) = &state.notice {
        body = body.push(text(notice.clone()).size(11).color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY));
    }
    body = body.push(Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(5.0)));

    if state.library.entries.is_empty() {
        body = body.push(empty_state());
    } else {
        let mut entries = column![].spacing(8);
        for entry in &state.library.entries {
            let expanded = state.expanded_library_entries.contains(&entry.key);
            let confirm = state.confirm_remove.as_deref() == Some(entry.key.as_str());
            entries = entries.push(entry_card(entry.clone(), expanded, confirm));
        }
        let content = container(entries)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .padding(Padding { top: 0.0, right: 18.0, bottom: 0.0, left: 0.0 });
        body = body.push(scrollable(content).width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill));
    }

    body.into()
}

fn entry_card(entry: LibraryEntry, expanded: bool, confirm: bool) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    let manifest_count = entry.manifest_count();
    let lua_count = entry.lua_count();
    let key = entry.key.clone();

    let title_block = column![
        text(entry.name.clone()).size(14).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
        components::separator(),
        text(format!("{manifest_count} manifests  ·  {lua_count} Lua files"))
            .size(11)
            .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
    ]
    .spacing(5)
    .width(Length::Fill);

    let toggle_label = if expanded { "Hide files  ▴" } else { "Show files  ▾" };
    let header = row![
        cover_art(entry.cover_path.clone(), &entry.name),
        title_block,
        column![
            components::action_button(toggle_label, Message::ToggleLibraryEntry(key.clone())),
            if confirm {
                components::danger_button("Delete files", Message::ConfirmRemove)
            } else {
                components::danger_button("Remove", Message::RequestRemove(key.clone()))
            },
        ]
        .spacing(6)
        .align_x(Alignment::End),
    ]
    .align_y(Alignment::Center)
    .spacing(12);

    let mut content = column![header].spacing(10);
    if confirm {
        content = content
            .push(components::separator())
            .push(
                text(format!(
                    "Delete the {} locally stored file(s)? This only removes the copies in the configured library folders.",
                    entry.files.len()
                ))
                .size(11)
                .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
            )
            .push(components::action_button("Cancel", Message::CancelRemove));
    }

    if expanded {
        content = content.push(components::separator());
        if entry.files.is_empty() {
            content = content.push(text("No files found for this game.").size(11).color(theme::TEXT_MUTED));
        } else {
            let mut files = column![].spacing(6);
            for file in &entry.files {
                let file_name = file
                    .path
                    .file_name()
                    .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("<unnamed>");
                files = files.push(
                    row![
                        container(text(file.kind.label().to_uppercase()).size(9).color(theme::TEXT_MUTED))
                            .padding(Padding { top: 4.0, right: 6.0, bottom: 4.0, left: 6.0 })
                            .style(|_theme| container::Style {
                                background: Some(theme::BG_ELEVATED.into()),
                                border: Border { color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                                ..Default::default()
                            }),
                        text(file_name.to_owned()).size(11).color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
                    ]
                    .spacing(9)
                    .align_y(Alignment::Center),
                );
            }
            content = content.push(files);
        }
    }

    container(content)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding { top: 12.0, right: 16.0, bottom: 12.0, left: 12.0 })
        .style(move |_theme| container::Style {
            background: Some(if confirm { theme::BG_ELEVATED } else { theme::BG_SURFACE }.into()),
            border: Border {
                color: if confirm { theme::TEXT_SECONDARY } else { theme::BORDER },
                width: 1.0,
                radius: theme::CORNER_RADIUS.into(),
            },
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .into()
}

fn cover_art(path: Option<std::path::PathBuf>, name: &str) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    let landscape = path.as_deref().is_some_and(is_landscape_art);
    let (slot_width, slot_height) = if landscape { (102.0, 48.0) } else { (54.0, 72.0) };

    if let Some(path) = path {
        let handle = cached_cover_handle(path, slot_width as u32, slot_height as u32);
        image::Image::new(handle)
            .width(Length::Fixed(slot_width))
            .height(Length::Fixed(slot_height))
            .content_fit(iced::ContentFit::Cover)
            .into()
    } else {
        let initial = name
            .chars()
            .next()
            .map(|character| character.to_uppercase().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "?".to_owned());
        container(text(initial).size(20).color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY))
            .width(Length::Fixed(slot_width))
            .height(Length::Fixed(slot_height))
            .center_x(Length::Fill)
            .center_y(Length::Fill)
            .style(|_theme| container::Style {
                background: Some(theme::BG_ELEVATED.into()),
                border: Border {
                    color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE,
                    width: 1.0,
                    radius: 6.0.into(),
                },
                ..Default::default()
            })
            .into()
    }
}

fn cached_cover_handle(path: std::path::PathBuf, width: u32, height: u32) -> image::Handle {
    let cache = COVER_HANDLES.get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));
    let mut handles = cache.lock().unwrap_or_else(|poisoned| poisoned.into_inner());
    
    let key = (path.clone(), width, height);
    if let Some(handle) = handles.get(&key) {
        return handle.clone();
    }
    
    let handle = match ::image::open(&path) {
        Ok(img) => {
            // 1. Smoothly scale the image down to the exact slot size
            let img = img.resize_exact(width, height, ::image::imageops::FilterType::Lanczos3);
            let mut rgba = img.to_rgba8();
            
            // 2. Manually apply the rounded corner mask with Anti-Aliasing
            let fw = width as f32;
            let fh = height as f32;
            let radius = 6.0_f32.min(fw / 2.0).min(fh / 2.0);
            
            for y in 0..height {
                for x in 0..width {
                    let fx = x as f32 + 0.5; // Pixel center X
                    let fy = y as f32 + 0.5; // Pixel center Y
                    
                    let mut alpha_multiplier = 1.0_f32;
                    
                    // Top-Left corner
                    if fx < radius && fy < radius {
                        let dist = ((fx - radius).powi(2) + (fy - radius).powi(2)).sqrt();
                        alpha_multiplier = (radius - dist + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    } 
                    // Top-Right corner
                    else if fx > fw - radius && fy < radius {
                        let dist = ((fx - (fw - radius)).powi(2) + (fy - radius).powi(2)).sqrt();
                        alpha_multiplier = (radius - dist + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    } 
                    // Bottom-Left corner
                    else if fx < radius && fy > fh - radius {
                        let dist = ((fx - radius).powi(2) + (fy - (fh - radius)).powi(2)).sqrt();
                        alpha_multiplier = (radius - dist + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    } 
                    // Bottom-Right corner
                    else if fx > fw - radius && fy > fh - radius {
                        let dist = ((fx - (fw - radius)).powi(2) + (fy - (fh - radius)).powi(2)).sqrt();
                        alpha_multiplier = (radius - dist + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    }
                    
                    if alpha_multiplier < 1.0 {
                        let pixel = rgba.get_pixel_mut(x, y);
                        // Blend the calculated smooth edge with the existing alpha channel
                        pixel.0[3] = (pixel.0[3] as f32 * alpha_multiplier) as u8;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            image::Handle::from_rgba(width, height, rgba.into_raw())
        }
        Err(_) => {
            // Fallback if image fails to load
            let mut rgba = vec![0u8; (width * height * 4) as usize];
            for i in 0..(width * height) {
                rgba[i as usize * 4] = 30;
                rgba[i as usize * 4 + 1] = 30;
                rgba[i as usize * 4 + 2] = 30;
                rgba[i as usize * 4 + 3] = 255;
            }
            image::Handle::from_rgba(width, height, rgba)
        }
    };
    
    handles.insert(key, handle.clone());
    handle
}



fn is_landscape_art(path: &std::path::Path) -> bool {
    path.file_name()
        .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
        .is_some_and(|name| name.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("header"))
}

fn empty_state() -> Element<'static, Message> {
    container(
        column![
            text("Nothing here yet").size(14).color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
            components::separator(),
            text("Import manifest and Lua files to populate your library.")
                .size(12)
                .color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
        ]
        .spacing(8)
        .align_x(Alignment::Center),
    )
    .width(Length::Fill)
    .height(Length::Fixed(220.0))
    .center_x(Length::Fill)
    .center_y(Length::Fill)
    .style(|_theme| container::Style {
        background: Some(theme::BG_SURFACE.into()),
        border: Border { color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE, width: 1.0, radius: theme::CORNER_RADIUS.into() },
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .into()
}


===== FILE: src\views\mod.rs =====
//! Root layout. The window is frameless, so the eight resize handles
//! around the edges are drawn here rather than supplied by the OS.

pub mod about;
pub mod components;
pub mod dropzone;
pub mod library;
pub mod options;
pub mod setup;
pub mod sidebar;
pub mod titlebar;

use iced::widget::{column, container, row, stack};
use iced::window::Direction;
use iced::{Element, Length};

use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::{State, View};
use crate::theme;

/// Builds the complete window layout.
pub fn root(state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    let shell = column![titlebar::view(state), body(state)].height(Length::Fill);

    let bordered = column![
        row![
            resize_handle(Direction::NorthWest, Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER), Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER)),
            resize_handle(Direction::North, Length::Fill, Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER)),
            resize_handle(Direction::NorthEast, Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER), Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER)),
        ],
        row![
            resize_handle(Direction::West, Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER), Length::Fill),
            container(shell).width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill),
            resize_handle(Direction::East, Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER), Length::Fill),
        ]
        .height(Length::Fill),
        row![
            resize_handle(Direction::SouthWest, Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER), Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER)),
            resize_handle(Direction::South, Length::Fill, Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER)),
            resize_handle(Direction::SouthEast, Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER), Length::Fixed(theme::RESIZE_BORDER)),
        ],
    ];

    let window_content: Element<'_, Message> = container(bordered)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .style(|_theme| container::Style {
            background: Some(theme::BG_BASE.into()),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .into();

    if state.storage_guide_open {
        stack![window_content, options::storage_guide_overlay()]
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .into()
    } else {
        window_content
    }
}

fn resize_handle(
    direction: Direction,
    width: Length,
    height: Length,
) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    components::resize_zone(direction, width, height)
}

fn body(state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    let layout = row![
        sidebar::view(state),
        container(content(state))
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .padding(24)
            .style(|_theme| container::Style {
                background: Some(theme::BG_BASE.into()),
                ..Default::default()
            }),
    ]
    .height(Length::Fill);

    container(layout)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .style(|_theme| container::Style {
            background: Some(theme::BG_BASE.into()),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .into()
}

fn content(state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    match state.active_view {
        View::Import => dropzone::view(state),
        View::Library => library::view(state),
        View::Options => options::view(state),
        View::Setup => setup::view(state),
        View::About => about::view(state),
    }
}

===== FILE: src\views\options.rs =====
//! Options screen and the contextual guide for configured storage locations.

use iced::widget::{column, container, mouse_area, row, scrollable, stack, text, text_input, Space};
use iced::{Alignment, Border, Color, Element, Length, Padding};

use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::State;
use crate::theme;
use crate::views::components;

/// Renders storage configuration and progressive-disclosure controls.
pub fn view(state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    // --- STATUS BAR ---
    let status_bar = if state.config_exists {
        container(
            row![
                text("Configuration file found. Configuration from software available.")
                    .size(12)
                    .color(Color::WHITE),
            ]
            .padding(10)
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .style(|_theme| container::Style {
            // Darker green background, brighter green border
            background: Some(Color::from_rgb(0.05, 0.15, 0.05).into()),
            border: Border { color: Color::from_rgb(0.2, 0.6, 0.2), width: 1.0, radius: 6.0.into() },
            ..Default::default()
        })
    } else {
        container(
            row![
                text("rustytools.toml not found in Steam root. You must create it before editing paths.")
                    .size(12)
                    .color(Color::WHITE)
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                components::action_button("Create Default Config", Message::CreateDefaultConfig),
            ]
            .spacing(10)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center)
            .padding(10)
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .style(|_theme| container::Style {
            background: Some(Color::from_rgb(0.7, 0.2, 0.2).into()), // Red warning
            border: Border { color: Color::from_rgb(0.5, 0.1, 0.1), width: 1.0, radius: 6.0.into() },
            ..Default::default()
        })
    };

    // --- LUA PATH EDITOR ---
    let lua_card_content = if state.config_exists {
        column![
            text("Lua storage").size(13).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
            components::separator(),
            text("RustyTools reads .lua files from this folder to unlock games and apply decryption keys.")
                .size(11)
                .color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
            row![
                text_input("Choose a local folder or leave blank for default", &state.lua_dir_draft)
                    .on_input(Message::LuaDirDraftChanged)
                    .padding(9)
                    .size(12)
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                components::action_button("Save", Message::SaveLuaDir),
            ]
            .spacing(8)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center),
        ]
        .spacing(8)
    } else {
        column![
            text("Lua storage").size(13).color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
            components::separator(),
            text("Locked. Create the configuration file first.")
                .size(11)
                .color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
            container(text(&state.lua_dir).size(12).color(theme::TEXT_MUTED))
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .padding(8)
                .style(|_theme| container::Style {
                    background: Some(theme::BG_ELEVATED.into()),
                    border: Border { color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                    ..Default::default()
                }),
        ]
        .spacing(8)
    };

    let mut body = column![
        components::page_header("Options", 20.0),
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
        
        status_bar,
        
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),

        // --- SECTION 1: STORAGE FOLDERS ---
        row![
            text("RustyTools Folders").size(14).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
            Space::new().width(Length::Fill),
            components::help_button(Message::OpenStorageGuide),
        ]
        .align_y(Alignment::Center),
        
        text("These are the folders where RustyTools reads its configuration and manifests.")
            .size(12)
            .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
            
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(2.0)),
        
        // Manifest card (Read Only)
        components::card(column![
            text("Manifest storage").size(13).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
            components::separator(),
            text("Steam reads .manifest files from this folder to download game files.")
                .size(11)
                .color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
            container(text(&state.manifest_dir).size(12).color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY))
                .width(Length::Fill)
                .padding(8)
                .style(|_theme| container::Style {
                    background: Some(theme::BG_ELEVATED.into()),
                    border: Border { color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE, width: 1.0, radius: 4.0.into() },
                    ..Default::default()
                }),
        ]
        .spacing(8)),
        
        // Lua card (Editable if config exists)
        components::card(lua_card_content),
        
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(15.0)),
        
        // --- SECTION 2: DIAGNOSTICS ---
        text("Diagnostics").size(14).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
        text("Advanced settings and internal behavior notes.")
            .size(12)
            .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
            
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(2.0)),
        
        components::card(column![
            components::toggle_row(
                "Advanced details",
                "Reveal additional information about how files are processed.",
                state.advanced_open,
                Message::ToggleAdvanced,
            ),
            components::separator(),
            text("Keep this closed unless you need the extra details.")
                .size(11)
                .color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
        ]
        .spacing(8)),
    ]
    .spacing(10);

    if let Some(notice) = &state.notice {
        body = body.push(text(notice.clone()).size(11).color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY));
    }

    if state.advanced_open {
        body = body.push(components::card(column![
            text("How it works").size(13).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
            components::separator(),
            text("Files are imported to the paths above. RustyTools reads them automatically when Steam starts. If you add or remove files while Steam is running, you must restart Steam for the changes to take effect.")
                .size(11)
                .color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
        ]
        .spacing(8)));
    }

    if state.rustytools_installed {
        body = body.push(Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(25.0)));
        body = body.push(
            components::card(column![
                text("Danger Zone").size(14).color(theme::DANGER),
                components::separator(),
                text("Removing RustyTools will disable game unlocking until you reinstall it. You must close Steam before removing.")
                    .size(11).color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
                Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
                components::danger_button("Remove RustyTools DLLs", Message::RemoveRustyTools),
            ].spacing(8))
        );
    }

    let padded_content = container(body)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .padding(Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: 18.0,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: 0.0,
        });
    
    let page: Element<'_, Message> = container(
        scrollable(padded_content)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fill),
    )
    .width(Length::Fill)
    .height(Length::Fill)
    .into();

    page
}

pub fn storage_guide_overlay() -> Element<'static, Message> {
    let backdrop = mouse_area(
        container(Space::new().width(Length::Fill).height(Length::Fill))
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .height(Length::Fill)
            .style(|_theme| container::Style {
                background: Some(theme::MODAL_BACKDROP.into()),
                ..Default::default()
            }),
    )
    .on_press(Message::StorageGuideBackdropPressed);

    let guide_content = column![
        guide_note(
            "The basics",
            "RustyTools works by combining Lua configuration files with Steam manifest files. This tricks Steam into downloading and launching games you don't own.",
        ),
        guide_section(
            "1. The two storage locations",
            "RustyTools and Steam read from these folders automatically. You do not need to change them.",
        ),
        row![
            guide_path_card(
                "Lua files",
                "<Steam>\\config\\stplug-in",
                "Unlocks games and provides decryption keys.",
            ),
            guide_path_card(
                "Manifest files",
                "<Steam>\\depotcache",
                "Tells Steam exactly what files to download.",
            ),
        ]
        .spacing(8),
        guide_file_group(),
        // Removed guide_action_group() from here
    ]
    .spacing(12);

    let panel = container(
        column![
            row![
                column![
                    text("Storage guide").size(17).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
                    text("How RustyTools uses your files.").size(10).color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
                ]
                .spacing(3),
                Space::new().width(Length::Fill),
                components::action_button("Close", Message::CloseStorageGuide),
            ]
            .align_y(Alignment::Center),
            components::separator(),
            scrollable(guide_content)
                .height(Length::Fill)
                .width(Length::Fill),
            row![
                text("You can reopen this guide from Options at any time.")
                    .size(10)
                    .color(theme::TEXT_MUTED)
                    .width(Length::Fill),
                components::primary_button_sized(
                    "Got it",
                    Message::CloseStorageGuide,
                    112.0,
                    38.0,
                ),
            ]
            .align_y(Alignment::Center),
        ]
        .spacing(10),
    )
    .width(Length::Fill)
    .max_width(660.0)
    .height(Length::Fixed(500.0))
    .padding(20)
    .style(|_theme| container::Style {
        background: Some(theme::BG_SURFACE.into()),
        border: Border {
            color: theme::BORDER,
            width: 1.0,
            radius: theme::CORNER_RADIUS.into(),
        },
        ..Default::default()
    });

    let centered_panel = container(panel)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .padding(12)
        .center_x(Length::Fill)
        .center_y(Length::Fill);

    stack![backdrop, centered_panel]
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .into()
}

fn guide_section(title: &'static str, body: &'static str) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    container(
        column![
            text(title).size(13).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
            components::separator(),
            text(body).size(12).color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
        ]
        .spacing(6),
    )
    .width(Length::Fill)
    .padding(10)
    .style(|_theme| container::Style {
        background: Some(theme::BG_ELEVATED.into()),
        border: Border {
            color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE,
            width: 1.0,
            radius: 6.0.into(),
        },
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .into()
}

fn guide_file_group() -> Element<'static, Message> {
    container(
        column![
            text("2. How the files work together").size(13).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
            components::separator(),
            text("RustyTools intercepts Steam's security checks using the data inside these files.")
                .size(12)
                .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
            guide_action(
                "Lua files",
                "Provide the App ID (the game), Depot IDs (the pieces of the game), and the AES decryption keys required to read the files.",
            ),
            components::separator(),
            guide_action(
                "Manifest files",
                "Provide the exact file structure. Steam reads these to know which files to download and verify from Valve's servers.",
            ),
            components::separator(),
            guide_action(
                "Why both?",
                "The Lua file tells Steam you own the game. The Manifest file tells Steam how to download it. Without both, the installation will fail.",
            ),
        ]
        .spacing(7),
    )
    .width(Length::Fill)
    .padding(10)
    .style(|_theme| container::Style {
        background: Some(theme::BG_ELEVATED.into()),
        border: Border {
            color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE,
            width: 1.0,
            radius: 6.0.into(),
        },
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .into()
}

// Removed guide_action_group() function entirely

fn guide_action(label: &'static str, detail: &'static str) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    row![
        text(label).size(12).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY).width(Length::Fixed(96.0)),
        text(detail)
            .size(12)
            .color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY)
            .width(Length::Fill),
    ]
    .spacing(8)
    .align_y(Alignment::Start)
    .into()
}

fn guide_path_card(
    title: &'static str,
    path: &'static str,
    detail: &'static str,
) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    container(
        column![
            text(title).size(12).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
            text(path).size(10).color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
            text(detail).size(10).color(theme::TEXT_MUTED),
        ]
        .spacing(5),
    )
    .width(Length::Fill)
    .padding(10)
    .style(|_theme| container::Style {
        background: Some(theme::BG_ELEVATED.into()),
        border: Border {
            color: theme::BORDER,
            width: 1.0,
            radius: 6.0.into(),
        },
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .into()
}

fn guide_note(title: &'static str, body: &'static str) -> Element<'static, Message> {
    container(
        column![
            text(title).size(12).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
            text(body).size(11).color(theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
        ]
        .spacing(4),
    )
    .width(Length::Fill)
    .padding(10)
    .style(|_theme| container::Style {
        background: Some(theme::BG_SURFACE.into()),
        border: Border {
            color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE,
            width: 1.0,
            radius: 6.0.into(),
        },
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .into()
}

===== FILE: src\views\setup.rs =====
use iced::widget::{column, container, text, Space};
use iced::{Alignment, Element, Length};
use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::{State, View};
use crate::theme;
use crate::views::components;

pub fn view(state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    let mut content = column![].spacing(10).align_x(Alignment::Center);

    // Force the text widget to take full width and center its internal lines
    let center_text = |txt: &str, size: f32, color: iced::Color| {
        text(txt.to_string())
            .size(size)
            .color(color)
            .width(Length::Fill)
            .align_x(Alignment::Center)
    };

    if let Some(progress) = state.setup_progress {
        if progress < 1.0 {
            content = content.push(
                components::card(column![
                    center_text("Installing RustyTools...", 16.0, theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
                    Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
                    center_text(&format!("{}%", (progress * 100.0) as u32), 12.0, theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
                    Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
                    iced::widget::progress_bar(0.0..=1.0, progress),
                ].spacing(5).align_x(Alignment::Center).width(Length::Fill))
            );
        } else {
            content = content.push(
                components::card(column![
                    center_text("Installation Complete!", 16.0, theme::SUCCESS),
                    Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
                    center_text("RustyTools has been successfully installed in your Steam directory.", 12.0, theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
                    Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(20.0)),
                    if state.steam_was_running {
                        column![
                            center_text("Steam is currently running. A restart is required for the changes to take effect.", 12.0, theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
                            Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
                            components::primary_button("Restart Steam Now", Message::RestartSteam),
                            Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
                            components::action_button("I'll restart it later", Message::Navigate(View::Import)),
                        ].spacing(5).align_x(Alignment::Center).width(Length::Fill)
                    } else {
                        column![
                            center_text("You can now launch Steam and start using RustyTools.", 12.0, theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
                            Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
                            components::primary_button("Continue to App", Message::Navigate(View::Import)),
                        ].spacing(5).align_x(Alignment::Center).width(Length::Fill)
                    }
                ].spacing(5).align_x(Alignment::Center).width(Length::Fill))
            );
        }
    } else if state.rustytools_installed {
        content = content.push(
            components::card(column![
                center_text("Already Installed", 16.0, theme::SUCCESS),
                Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
                center_text("RustyTools is already installed in your Steam directory.", 12.0, theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
                Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(20.0)),
                components::action_button("Continue to App", Message::Navigate(View::Import)),
            ].spacing(5).align_x(Alignment::Center).width(Length::Fill))
        );
    } else if let Some(error) = &state.setup_error {
        content = content.push(
            components::card(column![
                center_text("Installation Failed", 16.0, theme::DANGER),
                Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
                center_text(error, 12.0, theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
                Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(20.0)),
                components::primary_button("Retry Installation", Message::SetupInstall),
            ].spacing(5).align_x(Alignment::Center).width(Length::Fill))
        );
    } else {
        content = content.push(
            components::card(column![
                center_text("Install RustyTools", 16.0, theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
                Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(10.0)),
                center_text("RustyTools is required to unlock games in Steam. It was not detected in your Steam installation directory.", 12.0, theme::TEXT_SECONDARY),
                Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(20.0)),
                components::primary_button("Download & Install", Message::SetupInstall),
            ].spacing(5).align_x(Alignment::Center).width(Length::Fill))
        );
    }

    let card_container = container(content).width(Length::Fill).max_width(500.0);

    container(card_container)
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .center_x(Length::Fill)
        .center_y(Length::Fill)
        .into()
}

===== FILE: src\views\sidebar.rs =====
//! Left navigation rail. Deliberately sparse: four destinations.

use iced::widget::{column, container, Space};
use iced::{Border, Element, Length, Padding};

use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::{State, View};
use crate::theme;
use crate::views::components;

/// Renders the primary navigation rail.
pub fn view(state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    let icon = |glyph: iced::widget::Text<'static, iced::Theme, iced::Renderer>| {
        glyph.size(theme::NAV_ICON_SIZE).into()
    };

    let mut nav = column![
        components::section_label("Workspace"),
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(6.0)),
        components::separator(),
        Space::new().height(Length::Fixed(theme::SIDEBAR_LIBRARY_OFFSET)),
    ].spacing(4);

    if !state.rustytools_installed {
        nav = nav.push(components::nav_button(
            icon(lucide_icons::iced::icon_download()),
            "Setup",
            View::Setup,
            state.active_view == View::Setup,
        ));
    }

    nav = nav.push(components::nav_button(
        icon(lucide_icons::iced::icon_folder_input()),
        "Import files",
        View::Import,
        state.active_view == View::Import,
    ));
    nav = nav.push(components::nav_button(
        icon(lucide_icons::iced::icon_library()),
        "Library",
        View::Library,
        state.active_view == View::Library,
    ));
    nav = nav.push(components::nav_button(
        icon(lucide_icons::iced::icon_settings()),
        "Options",
        View::Options,
        state.active_view == View::Options,
    ));
    nav = nav.push(components::nav_button(
        icon(lucide_icons::iced::icon_info()),
        "About",
        View::About,
        state.active_view == View::About,
    ));

    container(
        column![nav, Space::new().height(Length::Fill)]
            .height(Length::Fill),
    )
    .width(Length::Fixed(theme::SIDEBAR_WIDTH))
    .height(Length::Fill)
    .padding(Padding {
        top: 16.0,
        right: 12.0,
        bottom: 16.0,
        left: 12.0,
    })
    .style(|_theme| container::Style {
        background: Some(theme::BG_SURFACE.into()),
        border: Border {
            color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE,
            width: 1.0,
            radius: iced::border::Radius {
                top_left: 0.0,
                top_right: 0.0,
                bottom_left: theme::CORNER_RADIUS,
                bottom_right: theme::CORNER_RADIUS,
            },
        },
        ..Default::default()
    })
    .into()
}

===== FILE: src\views\titlebar.rs =====
//! The custom frameless titlebar. Since the window is declared with
//! `decorations: false`, this file is responsible for the brand, the
//! window-drag region, and minimize / maximize / close.

use iced::widget::{container, mouse_area, row, text, Space};
use iced::{Alignment, Border, Element, Length};

use crate::app::APP_NAME;
use crate::message::Message;
use crate::state::State;
use crate::theme;
use crate::views::components;

/// Renders the custom titlebar and native window controls.
pub fn view(_state: &State) -> Element<'_, Message> {
    let drag_region = mouse_area(
        container(
            row![
                components::brand_icon(),
                text(APP_NAME).size(13).color(theme::TEXT_PRIMARY),
                Space::new().width(Length::Fill),
            ]
            .spacing(10)
            .align_y(Alignment::Center),
        )
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fill)
        .align_y(Alignment::Center)
        .padding(iced::Padding {
            top: 0.0,
            right: 14.0,
            bottom: 0.0,
            left: 14.0,
        }),
    )
    .on_press(Message::StartDrag);

    // Only the rightmost button rounds its top-right corner, so its hover
    // fill follows the window frame's rounding.
    let controls = row![
        components::titlebar_button(
            lucide_icons::iced::icon_minus()
                .size(theme::TITLEBAR_ICON_SIZE)
                .into(),
            Message::Minimize,
            false,
            false,
        ),
        components::titlebar_button(
            lucide_icons::iced::icon_square()
                .size(theme::TITLEBAR_ICON_SIZE)
                .into(),
            Message::ToggleMaximize,
            false,
            false,
        ),
        components::titlebar_button(
            lucide_icons::iced::icon_x()
                .size(theme::TITLEBAR_ICON_SIZE)
                .into(),
            Message::Close,
            true,
            true,
        ),
    ];

    container(row![drag_region, controls].align_y(Alignment::Center))
        .width(Length::Fill)
        .height(Length::Fixed(theme::TITLEBAR_HEIGHT))
        .style(|_theme| container::Style {
            background: Some(theme::BG_ELEVATED.into()),
            border: Border {
                color: theme::BORDER_SUBTLE,
                width: 1.0,
                radius: iced::border::Radius {
                    top_left: theme::CORNER_RADIUS,
                    top_right: theme::CORNER_RADIUS,
                    bottom_left: 0.0,
                    bottom_right: 0.0,
                },
            },
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .into()
}
